verses.1:1: And it happened in the thirtieth year, in the fourth, on the fifth of the month, while I was in the midst of the captives beside the river Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
verses.1:2: On the fifth of the month, that is, the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin,
verses.1:3: the word of the Lord came to Ezekiel the priest, son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans, alongside the river Chebar; and the hand of the Lord came upon him there.
verses.1:4: And I saw, and look, a whirling wind was coming from the north, and a great cloud, and an enfolding fire, and radiance all around it; and from its midst, something like the look of electrum, that is, from the midst of the fire;
verses.1:5: and in its midst was the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance: the likeness of a man was in them.
verses.1:6: Each one had four faces, and each one had four wings.
verses.1:7: Their feet were straight feet, and the sole of their foot was like the sole of a calf's foot; and there were sparks like the appearance of glowing bronze.
verses.1:8: And the hands of a man were under their wings on four sides, and they had faces and wings across the four sides.
verses.1:9: And their wings were joined one to another; they did not turn around when they advanced, but each one proceeded before its own face.
verses.1:10: Now as for the likeness of their faces: the face of a man and the face of a lion were on the right of the four of them, and the face of an ox on the left of the four of them, and the face of an eagle above the four of them.
verses.1:11: Their faces and their wings were extended above; two wings of each one were joined together, and two covered their bodies.
verses.1:12: And each one of them walked before its own face; wherever the impulse of the spirit was, there they proceeded, and they did not turn around when they walked.
verses.1:13: And as for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire and like the appearance of torches; this was a vision moving back and forth in the midst of the living creatures, a radiance of fire, and lightning coming forth from the fire.
verses.1:15: And as I gazed at the living creatures, one wheel appeared on the earth beside the living creatures, having four faces.
verses.1:16: And the appearance of the wheels and their work was like the sight of the sea; and the four of them had one likeness; and their appearance and their works were as if a wheel were in the middle of a wheel.
verses.1:17: As they went along their four sides, they kept going, and they did not turn around when they walked.
verses.1:18: The wheels also had stature, and height, and a fearsome appearance; and the entire body was full of eyes all around the four of them.
verses.1:19: And when the living creatures walked, the wheels also walked together beside them; and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were also lifted up at the same time.
verses.1:20: Wherever the spirit went, there, as the spirit went, the wheels also were lifted up together following it; for the spirit of life was in the wheels.
verses.1:21: When those went, they went, and when those stood, they stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels also were lifted up together following them, because the spirit of life was in the wheels.
verses.1:22: And over the heads of the living creatures was the likeness of an expanse, like the appearance of fearsome crystal, and stretched out over their heads above.
verses.1:23: And under the expanse their wings were straight, one toward another; each one veiled its own body with two wings, and the other was veiled in the same way.
verses.1:24: And I heard the sound of wings, like the sound of many waters, like the sound of the exalted God; when they walked, it was like the sound of a multitude, like the sound of an encampment; and when they stood, their wings were lowered.
verses.1:25: For when a voice came above the expanse that was over their head, they stood and lowered their wings.
verses.1:26: And above the expanse that was overhanging their head, like the appearance of a sapphire stone was the likeness of a throne; and upon the likeness of the throne was a likeness like the appearance of a man above.
verses.1:27: And I saw something like the look of electrum, like the appearance of fire inside it all around; from His loins and upward, and from His loins all the way downward, I saw something like the look of radiant fire all around,
verses.1:28: like the appearance of a bow when it is in a cloud on a day of rain. This was the appearance of the radiance in a circle all around.
verses.2:1: This was the vision of the likeness of the glory of the Lord. And I saw, and I fell on my face, and I heard the voice of One speaking, and He said to me, "Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you."
verses.2:2: And the Spirit entered into me after He spoke to me, and set me upon my feet; and I heard Him speaking to me,
verses.2:3: and saying, "Son of man, I am sending you to the sons of Israel, to apostate nations that have departed from Me; they and their fathers have transgressed My covenant up to this day,
verses.2:4: and they are sons of a hard face and an untamable heart, to whom I am sending you. And you shall say to them, 'This is what the Lord God says,'
verses.2:5: whether perhaps even they will listen, and whether perhaps they will desist—for it is a provoking house—and they will know that a prophet has been in their midst.
verses.2:6: Therefore you, son of man, do not fear them, and do not dread their sayings, because unbelievers and subverters are with you, and you live with scorpions. Do not fear their words, and do not be terrified of their faces, because it is a provoking house.
verses.2:7: Therefore you shall speak My words to them, if perhaps they will listen and desist, because they are provokers.
verses.2:8: But you, son of man, hear whatever I speak to you, and do not be provoking, as the provoking house is; open your mouth and eat whatever I give to you."
verses.2:9: And I saw, and look, a hand was sent out to me, in which was a rolled-up book; and He unrolled it before me, and it was written inside and outside, and written in it were lamentations, and a song, and woe.
verses.3:1: And He said to me, "Son of man, whatever you find, eat; eat this scroll, and go, speak to the sons of Israel."
verses.3:2: And I opened my mouth, and He fed me with that scroll,
verses.3:3: and He said to me, "Son of man, your belly will eat, and your inner parts will be filled with this scroll that I give to you." And I ate it, and it became in my mouth like sweet honey.
verses.3:4: And He said to me, "Son of man, go to the house of Israel, and you shall speak My words to them.
verses.3:5: For not to a people of deep speech and of an unknown language are you being sent—to the house of Israel;
verses.3:6: nor to many peoples of deep speech and of an unknown language, whose words you cannot understand; and if you were sent to them, they themselves would listen to you;
verses.3:7: but the house of Israel are unwilling to listen to you, because they are unwilling to listen to Me; for the entire house of Israel has a brazen forehead and a hard heart.
verses.3:8: Look, I have made your face stronger than their faces, and your forehead harder than their foreheads;
verses.3:9: like adamant and like flint I have made your face; do not fear them, and do not be in dread before their face, because it is a provoking house."
verses.3:10: And He said to me, "Son of man, all My words that I speak to you, receive in your heart and hear with your ears;
verses.3:11: and go, go in to the exiles, to the sons of your people, and you shall speak to them and say to them, 'This is what the Lord God says,' if perhaps they will listen and desist."
verses.3:12: And the Spirit took me up, and I heard behind me the sound of a great commotion: "Blessed be the glory of the Lord from His place,"
verses.3:13: and the sound of the wings of the living creatures striking one against another, and the sound of the wheels following the living creatures, and the sound of a great commotion.
verses.3:14: The Spirit also lifted me up and took me away; and I went away bitter in the indignation of my spirit, for the hand of the Lord was with me, strengthening me.
verses.3:15: And I came to the exiles, to the heap of new crops, to those who lived beside the river Chebar; and I sat where they were sitting, and I remained there seven days mourning in their midst.
verses.3:16: Now when seven days had passed, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.3:17: "Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel, and you shall hear a word from My mouth and declare it to them from Me.
verses.3:18: If, when I say to the wicked man, 'You will certainly die,' you do not declare it to him, nor speak so that he may turn away from his wicked way and live, that wicked man himself will die in his iniquity, but I will require his blood from your hand.
verses.3:19: But if you declare it to the wicked man, and he does not turn from his wickedness and from his wicked way, he himself indeed will die in his iniquity, but you have delivered your own soul.
verses.3:20: But also if a righteous man turns away from his righteousness and commits iniquity, I will place a stumbling block before him; he himself will die because you did not declare it to him. He will die in his sin, and his righteous deeds that he did will not be held in remembrance, yet I will require his blood from your hand.
verses.3:21: But if you declare to the righteous man that the righteous man should not sin, and he does not sin, he will certainly live, because you declared it to him, and you have delivered your own soul."
verses.3:22: And the hand of the Lord came upon me, and He said to me, "Rise up and go out into the plain, and there I will speak with you."
verses.3:23: And rising up, I went out into the plain; and look, the glory of the Lord was standing there, like the glory that I saw beside the river Chebar; and I fell on my face.
verses.3:24: And the Spirit entered into me and set me on my feet, and He spoke to me and said to me, "Go in and shut yourself in the midst of your house.
verses.3:25: And you, son of man, look, bonds have been placed upon you, and they will bind you with them, and you will not go out from their midst.
verses.3:26: And I will make your tongue cling to your palate, and you will be mute, and not like a man who rebukes, because it is a provoking house.
verses.3:27: But when I speak to you, I will open your mouth, and you shall say to them, 'This is what the Lord God says: Whoever listens, let him listen, and whoever desists, let him desist,' because it is a provoking house."
verses.4:1: "And you, son of man, take for yourself a brick, and you will place it before you and draw on it the city of Jerusalem.
verses.4:2: And you will set a siege against it, and build fortifications, and heap up a mound, and set camps against it, and place battering rams all around.
verses.4:3: And you, take for yourself an iron pan, and you will place it as an iron wall between you and the city; and you will set your face firmly toward it, and it will be under siege, and you will surround it: it is a sign to the house of Israel.
verses.4:4: And you will sleep on your left side, and you will place the iniquities of the house of Israel upon it, according to the number of days during which you will sleep on it; and you will take up their iniquity.
verses.4:5: Now I have given you the years of their iniquity, by the number of days, three hundred and ninety days; and you will bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
verses.4:6: And when you have completed these things, you will sleep on your right side a second time, and you will take up the iniquity of the house of Judah for forty days: a day for a year, a day, I say, for a year, I have given you.
verses.4:7: And you will turn your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and your arm will be outstretched, and you will prophesy against it.
verses.4:8: Look, I have surrounded you with bonds, and you will not turn yourself from your side to another side until you complete the days of your siege.
verses.4:9: And you, take for yourself wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentils, and millet, and vetch, and you will put them into one vessel and make for yourself loaves according to the number of days during which you will sleep on your side: for three hundred and ninety days you will eat it.
verses.4:10: Now your food that you will eat will be by weight twenty staters a day; from time to time you will eat it.
verses.4:11: And you will drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin; from time to time you will drink it.
verses.4:12: And you will eat it like a barley cake baked under the ashes, and with the excrement that comes out from a man you will cover it before their eyes."
verses.4:13: And the Lord said, "In this way the sons of Israel will eat their defiled bread among the nations to which I will cast them out." And I said,
verses.4:14: "Ah, ah, ah, Lord God, look, my soul has not been defiled, and I have not eaten what died of itself or what was torn by beasts from my infancy until now, and no unclean flesh has entered into my mouth."
verses.4:15: And He said to me, "Look, I have given you cattle dung instead of human excrement, and you will make your bread on it."
verses.4:16: And He said to me, "Son of man, look, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem, and they will eat bread by weight and in anxiety, and they will drink water by measure and in distress,
verses.4:17: so that, as bread and water fail, each one may collapse toward his brother, and they may waste away in their iniquities."
verses.5:1: "And you, son of man, take for yourself a sharp sword that shaves hairs, and you will take it and draw it over your head and over your beard, and you will take for yourself scales for weighing and divide them.
verses.5:2: You will burn a third part with fire in the midst of the city at the completion of the days of the siege, and you will take a third part and cut it up with the sword all around it; and another third you will scatter to the wind, and I will bare the sword after them.
verses.5:3: And you will take from there a small number and bind them in the edge of your cloak;
verses.5:4: and from them you will take again, and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them with fire; and from it fire will go out into all the house of Israel."
verses.5:5: This is what the Lord God says: "This is Jerusalem: I have placed her in the midst of the nations, and lands all around her.
verses.5:6: And she has despised My judgments so as to be more wicked than the nations, and My precepts more than the lands that are around her; for they have cast away My judgments, and they have not walked in My precepts."
verses.5:7: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: "Because you have surpassed the nations that are around you, and have not walked in My precepts, and have not carried out My judgments, and have not acted according to the judgments of the nations that are around you,"
verses.5:8: therefore this is what the Lord God says: "Look, I am against you, and I Myself will execute judgments in your midst before the eyes of the nations,
verses.5:9: and I will do in you what I have not done, and the like of which I will not do again, because of all your abominations.
verses.5:10: Therefore fathers will eat sons in your midst, and sons will eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments in you, and I will winnow all your remnants to every wind.
verses.5:11: Therefore, as I live," says the Lord God, "surely, because you have violated My sanctuary with all your offenses and with all your abominations, I also will break in pieces, and My eye will not spare, and I will not have mercy.
verses.5:12: A third part of you will die by plague and be consumed by famine in your midst, and a third part of you will fall by the sword all around you; and your third part I will scatter to every wind, and I will unsheathe the sword after them.
verses.5:13: And I will complete My fury, and make My indignation rest upon them, and I will be consoled; and they will know that I, the Lord, have spoken in My zeal, when I have fulfilled My indignation upon them.
verses.5:14: And I will make you a wasteland and a reproach to the nations that are around you, in the sight of everyone passing by;
verses.5:15: and you will be a reproach and a reviling, an example and an astonishment among the nations that are around you, when I execute judgments in you in fury, and in indignation, and in rebukes of wrath.
verses.5:16: I, the Lord, have spoken: when I send the worst arrows of famine against them, which will be deadly and which I will send to destroy you, I will also gather famine upon you and break the staff of bread among you;
verses.5:17: and I will send against you famine and the worst beasts, even to utter destruction; and pestilence and blood will pass through you, and I will bring the sword upon you. I, the Lord, have spoken."
verses.6:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.6:2: "Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and you will prophesy to them,
verses.6:3: and you will say, 'Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord God. This is what the Lord God says to the mountains and hills, to the cliffs and valleys: Look, I will bring the sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places,
verses.6:4: and I will demolish your altars, and your images will be shattered, and I will cast down those of you who are killed before your idols;
verses.6:5: and I will place the corpses of the sons of Israel before the face of your images, and I will scatter your bones around your altars;
verses.6:6: in all your dwelling places the cities will be deserted, and the high places will be demolished and ruined; and your altars will perish and be shattered, and your idols will cease, and your shrines will be crushed, and your works will be wiped out;
verses.6:7: and one who is killed will fall in your midst, and you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.6:8: And I will leave among you those who escape the sword among the nations, when I have scattered you in the lands;
verses.6:9: and those of you who are delivered will remember Me among the nations to which they were led captive, because I have crushed their heart that fornicates and departs from Me, and their eyes that fornicate after their idols; and they will be displeasing to themselves over the evils that they have done in all their abominations.
verses.6:10: And they will know that I, the Lord, have not spoken in vain to do this evil to them.'"
verses.6:11: This is what the Lord God says: "Strike your hand and stamp your foot, and say, 'Alas, over all the abominations of the evils of the house of Israel, because by sword, famine, and plague they are about to fall!'
verses.6:12: The one who is far away will die by plague, and the one who is near will fall by the sword, and the one who is left and besieged will die by famine; and I will complete My indignation upon them.
verses.6:13: And you will know that I am the Lord, when those of you who are killed are in the midst of your idols, all around your altars, on every high hill, and on all the summits of the mountains, and under every shady tree, and under every leafy oak, the place where they burned fragrant incense to all their idols.
verses.6:14: And I will stretch out My hand over them, and I will make the land desolate and destitute, from the desert of Deblatha, in all their dwelling places; and they will know that I am the Lord."
verses.7:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.7:2: "And you, son of man, this is what the Lord God says to the land of Israel: 'The end has come; the end has come upon the four quarters of the land.
verses.7:3: The end has come, the end has come; it has awakened against you; look, it is coming.
verses.7:4: Ruin has come upon you, who dwell in the land; the time has come, the day of slaughter is near, and not of the glory of the mountains.
verses.7:5: Now shortly I will pour out My wrath upon you, and I will complete My fury against you; and I will judge you according to your ways, and I will lay all your crimes upon you,
verses.7:6: and My eye will not spare, nor will I have pity; but I will lay your ways upon you, and your abominations will be in your midst, and you will know that I am the Lord who strikes.
verses.7:7: Now the end is upon you, and I will send My fury against you; and I will judge you according to your ways, and I will set all your abominations against you.
verses.7:8: And My eye will not spare you, and I will not have pity; but I will set your ways upon you, and your abominations will be in your midst, and you will know that I am the Lord.'
verses.7:10: This is what the Lord God says: 'One affliction, an affliction, look, it is coming! Look, the day! Look, it is coming! Ruin has gone out, the rod has blossomed, pride has sprouted,
verses.7:11: iniquity has risen up in a rod of wickedness. None of them, and none of the people, nor of their sound; and there will be no rest among them.
verses.7:12: The time has come, the day has drawn near: let the one who buys not rejoice, and let the one who sells not mourn, for wrath is upon all its people.
verses.7:13: For the one who sells will not return to what he sold, and their life is still among the living; for the vision concerning all its multitude will not turn back, and a man in the iniquity of his life will not be strengthened.
verses.7:14: Blow the trumpet, let all be prepared; yet there is no one who goes to battle, for My wrath is upon its entire people.
verses.7:15: The sword is outside, and plague and famine are inside; the one who is in the field will die by the sword, and those who are in the city will be devoured by pestilence and famine.
verses.7:16: And those of them who flee will be saved, and they will be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all trembling, each one in his iniquity.
verses.7:17: All hands will go limp, and all knees will flow with water.
verses.7:18: And they will bind sackcloth around themselves, and dread will cover them; and shame will be on every face, and baldness on all their heads.
verses.7:19: Their silver will be thrown outside, and their gold will become a dung heap; their silver and their gold will not be able to deliver them on the day of the fury of the Lord. They will not satisfy their soul, and their bellies will not be filled, because it has become the stumbling block of their iniquity.
verses.7:20: And they set the ornament of their jewels for pride, and from it they made images of their abominations and idols; because of this I have given it to them as uncleanness.
verses.7:21: And I will give it into the hands of foreigners for plundering, and to the wicked of the earth as spoil, and they will defile it.
verses.7:22: And I will turn My face away from them, and they will violate My secret place; and emissaries will enter into it, and they will defile it.
verses.7:23: Make a confinement, because the land is full of the judgment of bloodshed, and the city is full of iniquity.
verses.7:24: And I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will possess their houses; and I will make the pride of the mighty cease, and they will possess their sanctuaries.
verses.7:25: When distress comes upon them, they will seek peace, and there will be none.
verses.7:26: Trouble upon trouble will come, and report upon report; and they will seek a vision from the prophet, and the law will perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.
verses.7:27: The king will mourn, and the prince will be clothed with grief, and the hands of the people of the land will be troubled; according to their way I will do to them, and according to their judgments I will judge them, and they will know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.8:1: And it happened in the sixth year, in the sixth month, on the fifth of the month, I was sitting in my house, and the elders of Judah were sitting before me, and the hand of the Lord God fell upon me there.
verses.8:2: And I saw, and look, a likeness like the appearance of fire: from the appearance of His waist downward, fire; and from His waist upward, like the appearance of brightness, as the sight of electrum.
verses.8:3: And the likeness of a hand was stretched out and seized me by a lock of my head, and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven and brought me into Jerusalem, in a vision of God, beside the inner entrance that faced toward the north, where the idol of jealousy was set up to provoke jealousy.
verses.8:4: And look, there was the glory of the God of Israel, according to the vision that I had seen in the plain.
verses.8:5: And He said to me, "Son of man, lift up your eyes toward the way of the north." And I lifted up my eyes toward the way of the north, and look, to the north of the gate of the altar was the idol of jealousy in the very entryway.
verses.8:6: And He said to me, "Son of man, do you think you see what these people are doing, the great abominations that the house of Israel is doing here, so that I should withdraw far from My sanctuary? And turning yet again, you will see greater abominations."
verses.8:7: And He brought me in to the entrance of the court, and I saw, and look, one hole in the wall.
verses.8:8: And He said to me, "Son of man, dig through the wall." And when I had dug through the wall, one doorway appeared.
verses.8:9: And He said to me, "Go in, and see the worst abominations that these people are doing here."
verses.8:10: And having gone in, I saw, and look, every likeness of creeping things and animals, an abomination, and all the idols of the house of Israel were painted on the wall all around throughout;
verses.8:11: and seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel; and Jaazaniah son of Shaphan was standing in the midst of them as they stood before the paintings; and each one had a censer in his hand, and a vapor of mist was rising from the incense.
verses.8:12: And He said to me, "Surely you see, son of man, what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the dark, each one in the hidden place of his chamber; for they say, 'The Lord does not see us; the Lord has abandoned the land.'"
verses.8:13: And He said to me, "Turning yet again, you will see greater abominations that these people are doing."
verses.8:14: And He brought me in through the entrance of the gate of the house of the Lord that faced toward the north, and look, there women were sitting, mourning Adonis.
verses.8:15: And He said to me, "Surely you have seen, son of man; turning yet again, you will see greater abominations than these."
verses.8:16: And He brought me into the inner court of the house of the Lord, and look, at the entrance of the temple of the Lord, between the vestibule and the altar, were about twenty-five men, having their backs toward the temple of the Lord and their faces toward the east; and they were worshiping toward the rising of the sun.
verses.8:17: And He said to me, "Surely you have seen, son of man. Is this a light thing to the house of Judah, that they should do these abominations which they have done here, because, filling the land with iniquity, they have turned again to provoke Me? And look, they hold the branch to their noses.
verses.8:18: Therefore I also will act in fury: My eye will not spare, nor will I have pity; and when they cry out to My ears with a loud voice, I will not listen to them."
verses.9:1: And He cried out in my ears with a loud voice, saying, "The visitations of the city have drawn near, and each one has an instrument of slaughter in his hand."
verses.9:2: And look, six men were coming from the way of the upper gate, which faces toward the north, and each one's instrument of destruction was in his hand; one man also in their midst was dressed in linen, and a writer's inkhorn was at his side; and they went in and stood beside the bronze altar.
verses.9:3: And the glory of the Lord of Israel was lifted up from the cherub on which it was, to the threshold of the house; and He called to the man who was clothed in linen and had the writer's inkhorn at his waist,
verses.9:4: and the Lord said to him, "Pass through the middle of the city, in the midst of Jerusalem, and mark a tau upon the foreheads of the men sighing and grieving over all the abominations that are done in its midst."
verses.9:5: And to the others He said, in my hearing, "Pass through the city following him, and strike: let your eye not spare, nor have pity;
verses.9:6: kill old man, young man and virgin, little child and women to utter destruction; but do not kill anyone upon whom you see the tau, and begin at My sanctuary." So they began with the elder men who were before the front of the house.
verses.9:7: And He said to them, "Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slaughtered; go out." And they went out and were striking those who were in the city.
verses.9:8: And when the slaughter was completed, I remained, and I fell upon my face, and crying out I said, "Ah! Ah! Ah! Lord God, will You then destroy all the remnant of Israel, pouring out Your fury upon Jerusalem?"
verses.9:9: And He said to me, "The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is very exceedingly great, and the land is filled with bloodshed, and the city is filled with turning away; for they have said, 'The Lord has abandoned the land, and the Lord does not see.'
verses.9:10: Therefore My eye also will not spare, nor will I have pity; I will repay their way upon their head."
verses.9:11: And look, the man who was clothed in linen, who had the inkhorn on his back, replied with a word, saying, "I have done just as You commanded me."
verses.10:1: And I saw, and look, in the expanse that was above the head of the cherubim, something like a sapphire stone, like the appearance of the likeness of a throne, appeared above them.
verses.10:2: And He spoke to the man who was clothed in linen and said, "Enter into the midst of the wheels that are beneath the cherubim, and fill your hand with coals of fire that are among the cherubim, and pour them out over the city." And he entered in my sight.
verses.10:3: Now the cherubim were standing on the right side of the house when the man was entering, and a cloud filled the inner court.
verses.10:4: And the glory of the Lord was lifted up from above the cherub to the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was filled with the splendor of the glory of the Lord.
verses.10:5: And the sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard as far as the outer court, like the voice of Almighty God speaking.
verses.10:6: And when He had commanded the man who was clothed in linen, saying, "Take fire from the midst of the wheels that are among the cherubim," he entered and stood beside a wheel.
verses.10:7: And a cherub stretched out his hand from the midst of the cherubim to the fire that was among the cherubim, and took some, and put it into the hands of the one who was clothed in linen, who received it and went out.
verses.10:8: And there appeared on the cherubim the likeness of a man's hand beneath their wings.
verses.10:9: And I saw, and look, four wheels beside the cherubim: one wheel beside one cherub, and another wheel beside another cherub; and the appearance of the wheels was like the sight of a chrysolite stone.
verses.10:10: And their aspect was one likeness for the four, as if a wheel were in the midst of a wheel.
verses.10:11: And when they went, they proceeded in four directions, and they did not turn back as they went; rather, to the place toward which the one that was first inclined to go, the others also followed, and they did not turn around.
verses.10:12: And their whole body, and necks, and hands, and wings, and circles were full of eyes all around the four wheels.
verses.10:13: And He called these wheels "Whirling" in my hearing.
verses.10:15: And the cherubim were lifted up; this is the very living creature that I had seen beside the river Chebar.
verses.10:16: And when the cherubim went, the wheels also went alongside them; and when the cherubim lifted their wings to be raised up from the earth, the wheels did not stay behind, but they themselves also were beside them.
verses.10:17: When those stood, they stood, and together with those lifted up, they were lifted up; for the spirit of life was in them.
verses.10:18: And the glory of the Lord went out from the threshold of the temple and stood above the cherubim.
verses.10:19: And the cherubim, lifting their wings, were raised up from the earth before me; and as they went out, the wheels also followed after; and it stood at the entrance of the east gate of the house of the Lord, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
verses.10:20: This is the very living creature that I saw beneath the God of Israel beside the river Chebar, and I understood that they were cherubim.
verses.10:21: Each one had four faces, and each one had four wings, and the likeness of a man's hand was under their wings.
verses.10:22: And the likeness of their faces was the very faces that I had seen beside the river Chebar, and their look; and the impulse of each one was to proceed before its face.
verses.11:1: And the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the east gate of the house of the Lord, which faces toward the rising of the sun; and look, at the entrance of the gate were twenty-five men, and I saw in the midst of them Jaazaniah son of Azzur, and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.
verses.11:2: And He said to me, "Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity and plot the worst counsel in this city,
verses.11:3: saying, 'Were not the houses built recently? This is the cauldron, and we are the meat.'
verses.11:4: Therefore prophesy about them; prophesy, son of man."
verses.11:5: And the Spirit of the Lord rushed upon me and said to me, "Speak: This is what the Lord says, 'So you have spoken, house of Israel, and I know the thoughts of your heart.
verses.11:6: You have killed very many in this city, and you have filled its streets with those who were killed.'
verses.11:7: Therefore this is what the Lord God says, 'Those killed by you, whom you have placed in the midst of it, these are the meat, and this is the cauldron; and I will bring you out from the midst of it.
verses.11:8: You have feared the sword, and I will bring the sword upon you,' says the Lord God.
verses.11:9: 'And I will cast you out from the midst of it, and I will give you into the hand of enemies, and I will execute judgments upon you.
verses.11:10: By the sword you will fall; at the borders of Israel I will judge you, and you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.11:11: This will not be a cauldron for you, and you will not be meat in the midst of it; at the borders of Israel I will judge you,
verses.11:12: and you will know that I am the Lord, because you have not walked in My precepts and have not carried out My judgments, but have acted according to the judgments of the nations that are all around you.'"
verses.11:13: And it happened, while I was prophesying, that Pelatiah son of Benaiah died; and I fell upon my face, crying out with a loud voice, and said, "Alas, alas, alas, Lord God! Are You making a complete end of the remnant of Israel?"
verses.11:14: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.11:15: "Son of man, your brothers, your brothers, the men who are your kinsmen, and all the house of Israel, all of them, are those to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, 'Depart far from the Lord; to us the land has been given as a possession.'
verses.11:16: Therefore this is what the Lord God says, 'Because I have removed them far off among the nations, and because I have scattered them among the lands, I will be to them a little sanctification in the lands to which they have come.'
verses.11:17: Therefore speak: This is what the Lord God says, 'I will gather you from the peoples, and unite you from the lands in which you have been scattered, and I will give you the soil of Israel.
verses.11:18: And they will enter there, and they will remove all the offenses and all its abominations from it.
verses.11:19: And I will give them one heart, and I will bestow a new spirit in their inward parts; and I will remove the stony heart from their flesh and give them a heart of flesh,
verses.11:20: so that they may walk in My precepts, and keep My judgments and carry them out, and be a people to Me, and I may be God to them.
verses.11:21: As for those whose heart walks after their stumbling blocks and abominations, I will place their way upon their own head,' says the Lord God."
verses.11:22: And the cherubim lifted their wings, and the wheels were with them, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
verses.11:23: And the glory of the Lord ascended from the midst of the city and stood upon the mountain that is to the east of the city.
verses.11:24: And the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into Chaldea to the exiles, in a vision, in the Spirit of God; and the vision that I had seen was lifted away from me.
verses.11:25: And I spoke to the exiles all the words of the Lord that He had shown me.
verses.12:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.12:2: "Son of man, you live in the midst of a provoking house, who have eyes to see and do not see, and ears to hear and do not hear, because it is a provoking house.
verses.12:3: You therefore, son of man, make for yourself baggage for exile, and you will go into exile by day before them. And you will go into exile from your place to another place in their sight, if perhaps they will take notice, because it is a provoking house.
verses.12:4: And you will bring your baggage outside like the baggage of one going into exile by day in their sight; but you yourself will go out in the evening before them, just as one departing goes out.
verses.12:5: Before their eyes dig through the wall for yourself, and you will go out through it.
verses.12:6: In their sight you will be carried on shoulders; in darkness you will be brought out. You will veil your face and will not see the land, because I have given you as a portent to the house of Israel."
verses.12:7: Therefore I did just as the Lord had commanded me: I brought out my baggage like the baggage of one going into exile by day, and in the evening I dug through the wall for myself by hand; and in darkness I went out, carried on shoulders in their sight.
verses.12:8: And the word of the Lord came to me in the morning, saying:
verses.12:9: "Son of man, has not the house of Israel, the provoking house, said to you, 'What are you doing?'
verses.12:10: Say to them, 'This is what the Lord God says: This burden is upon the leader who is in Jerusalem, and upon all the house of Israel that is in their midst.'
verses.12:11: Say, 'I am your portent; just as I have done, so it will be done to them: they will go into exile and into captivity.'
verses.12:12: And the leader who is in their midst will be carried on shoulders; in darkness he will go out. They will dig through the wall to bring him out; his face will be covered, so that he may not see the land with his eye.
verses.12:13: And I will spread My net over him, and he will be caught in My dragnet; and I will bring him to Babylon, to the land of the Chaldeans, yet he will not see it, and there he will die.
verses.12:14: And all who are around him, his guard and his troops, I will scatter to every wind, and I will unsheathe a sword after them.
verses.12:15: And they will know that I am the Lord, when I have scattered them among the nations and dispersed them through the lands.
verses.12:16: And I will leave a few men of them from the sword, and famine, and pestilence, so that they may recount all their wicked deeds among the nations that they will enter, and they will know that I am the Lord."
verses.12:17: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.12:18: "Son of man, eat your bread in agitation, and also drink your water in haste and sorrow.
verses.12:19: And you will say to the people of the land, 'This is what the Lord God says to those who live in Jerusalem, in the land of Israel: They will eat their bread in anxiety, and they will drink their water in desolation, so that the land may be made desolate of its multitude, because of the iniquity of all who live in it.
verses.12:20: And the cities that are now inhabited will be desolate, and the land deserted; and you will know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.12:21: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.12:22: "Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel, saying, 'The days will be put off for a long time, and every vision will perish'?
verses.12:23: Therefore say to them, 'This is what the Lord God says: I will make this proverb cease, and it will no longer be commonly spoken in Israel.' And tell them that the days have drawn near, and the word of every vision.
verses.12:24: For there will no longer be any futile vision nor ambiguous divination in the midst of the sons of Israel;
verses.12:25: because I, the Lord, will speak, and whatever word I speak will come to pass, and it will not be delayed any more; but in your days, provoking house, I will speak a word and will do it, says the Lord God."
verses.12:26: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.12:27: "Son of man, look, the house of Israel is saying, 'The vision that this man sees is for many days, and he prophesies for distant times.'
verses.12:28: Therefore say to them, 'This is what the Lord God says: Not one word of Mine will be delayed any longer; the word that I speak will be fulfilled, says the Lord God.'"
verses.13:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.13:2: "Son of man, prophesy to the prophets of Israel who prophesy, and you will say to those who prophesy from their own heart, 'Hear the word of the Lord.
verses.13:3: This is what the Lord God says: Woe to the foolish prophets, who follow their own spirit and see nothing!
verses.13:4: Like foxes in the deserts were your prophets, Israel.
verses.13:5: You have not gone up in opposition, nor have you set up a wall for the house of Israel, so that you might stand in battle on the day of the Lord.
verses.13:6: They see empty things and divine falsehood, saying, "The Lord says," when the Lord has not sent them; and they have persisted in confirming the word.
verses.13:7: Have you not seen a futile vision and spoken a lying divination, and you say, "The Lord says," when I have not spoken?
verses.13:8: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: Because you have spoken empty things and have seen falsehood, therefore, look, I am against you, says the Lord God.
verses.13:9: And My hand will be upon the prophets who see empty things and divine falsehood; they will not be in the council of My people, and they will not be written in the register of the house of Israel, nor will they enter into the land of Israel; and you will know that I am the Lord God,
verses.13:10: because they have deceived My people, saying, "Peace," and there is no peace; and the people itself was building a wall, while they were coating it with clay without straw.'
verses.13:11: Say to those who coat without tempering that it is going to fall; for there will be a flooding rain, and I will send huge stones rushing down from above, and a shattering storm wind.
verses.13:12: Indeed, look, the wall has fallen; will it not be said to you, 'Where is the coating that you applied?'
verses.13:13: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: And I will make a wind of tempests break forth in My indignation, and there will be a flooding rain in My fury, and great stones in wrath for destruction.
verses.13:14: And I will tear down the wall that you coated without tempering, and I will level it to the ground, and its foundation will be uncovered; and it will fall, and will be consumed in its midst, and you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.13:15: And I will complete My indignation upon the wall and upon those who coat it without tempering; and I will say to you, 'The wall is no more, and those who coat it are no more:
verses.13:16: the prophets of Israel, who prophesy to Jerusalem and see for it a vision of peace, and there is no peace,' says the Lord God.
verses.13:17: And you, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy from their own heart, and prophesy over them,
verses.13:18: and say, 'This is what the Lord God says: Woe to those who sew cushions under every elbow of the hand and make pillows under the head of every age to capture souls; and when they captured the souls of My people, they kept their souls alive!
verses.13:19: And they profaned Me among My people for a handful of barley and a piece of bread, to put to death souls that do not die and to keep alive souls that do not live, lying to My people who believe lies.
verses.13:20: Because of this, this is what the Lord God says: Look, I am against your cushions with which you capture flying souls; and I will tear them from your arms, and I will release the souls that you capture, souls to fly.
verses.13:21: And I will tear apart your pillows, and I will free My people from your hand, and they will no longer be in your hands to be preyed upon; and you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.13:22: Because you have falsely made the heart of the righteous grieve, whom I did not sadden, and you have strengthened the hands of the wicked, so that he would not turn back from his evil way and live,
verses.13:23: therefore you will not see empty things, and you will no longer divine divinations, and I will rescue My people from your hand; and you will know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.14:1: And men from the elders of Israel came to me and sat down before me.
verses.14:2: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.14:3: "Son of man, these men have placed their impurities in their hearts and have set up the stumbling block of their iniquity in front of their face. When inquired of, will I really answer them?
verses.14:4: For this reason, speak to them and you will say to them, 'The Lord God says this: Each and every man from the house of Israel who places his impurities in his heart, and sets up the stumbling block of his iniquity in front of his face, and comes to a prophet inquiring of Me through him—I, the Lord, will answer him in the multitude of his impurities,
verses.14:5: so that the house of Israel may be captured in its heart, by which they have departed from Me in all their idols.'
verses.14:6: Therefore say to the house of Israel, 'The Lord God says this: Turn back and depart from your idols, and turn your faces away from all your defilements.
verses.14:7: For each and every man from the house of Israel, and from the proselytes, whoever is a resident alien in Israel, if he becomes estranged from Me, and places his idols in his heart, and sets up the stumbling block of his iniquity in front of his face, and comes to a prophet to inquire of Me through him—I, the Lord, will answer him by Myself;
verses.14:8: and I will set My face against that man, and I will make him into an example and a proverb, and I will destroy him from the midst of My people; and you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.14:9: And when a prophet goes astray and speaks a word, I, the Lord, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out My hand against him and blot him out from the midst of My people Israel.
verses.14:10: And they will bear their iniquity; according to the iniquity of the inquirer, so will the iniquity of the prophet be,
verses.14:11: so that the house of Israel may no longer go astray from Me, nor be polluted in all its transgressions, but that they may be a people for Me, and I may be God for them, says the Lord of hosts.'"
verses.14:12: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.14:13: "Son of man, when a land sins against Me so that it truly transgresses, I will stretch out My hand against it, and I will break its staff of bread, and I will send famine into it, and I will kill man and beast from it.
verses.14:14: And if these three men are in its midst—Noah, Daniel, and Job—they themselves by their righteousness will deliver their own lives, says the Lord of hosts.
verses.14:15: Now if I also bring the worst beasts upon the land to lay it waste, and it becomes impassable because there is no one passing through on account of the beasts,
verses.14:16: if these three men are in it, as I live, says the Lord God, indeed they will deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they alone will be delivered, while the land will be made desolate.
verses.14:17: Or if I bring a sword upon that land, and say to the sword, 'Pass through the land,' and I kill man and beast from it,
verses.14:18: and these three men are in its midst: as I live, says the Lord God, they will not deliver sons or daughters, but they alone will be delivered.
verses.14:19: But if I also send pestilence upon that land, and pour out My indignation upon it in blood, to remove man and beast from it,
verses.14:20: and Noah, and Daniel, and Job are in its midst: as I live, says the Lord God, indeed they will not deliver a son or a daughter, but they themselves by their righteousness will deliver their own lives.
verses.14:21: For the Lord God says this: Even if I send My four worst judgments—sword, and famine, and evil beasts, and pestilence—into Jerusalem to kill man and livestock from it,
verses.14:22: yet there will be left in it a deliverance of those leading out sons and daughters; look, they themselves will come in to you, and you will see their way and their contrivances, and you will be consoled over the calamity that I have brought upon Jerusalem, in all things that I have brought in upon it.
verses.14:23: And they will console you when you see their way and their contrivances; and you will recognize that I have not done without reason everything that I have done in it, says the Lord God."
verses.15:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.15:2: "Son of man, what will become of the wood of the vine, out of all the trees of the groves that are among the trees of the forests?
verses.15:3: Will wood really be taken from it for any work to be made, or will a peg be fashioned from it so that any vessel at all may hang on it?
verses.15:4: Look, it has been given to the fire for food: fire has consumed both ends of it, and its middle has been reduced to ashes. Will it really be useful for work?
verses.15:5: Even when it was intact, it was not fit for work; how much more, when fire has devoured it and burned it up, will no work be made from it?
verses.15:6: Therefore, the Lord God says this: Just as the wood of the vine among the trees of the forests, which I have given to the fire to be devoured, so I will hand over the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.15:7: And I will set My face against them; they will go out from the fire, and fire will consume them; and you will know that I am the Lord when I set My face against them,
verses.15:8: and render the land impassable and desolate, because they have proved to be transgressors, says the Lord God."
verses.16:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.16:2: "Son of man, make her abominations known to Jerusalem,
verses.16:3: and you shall say, 'This is what the Lord God says to Jerusalem: Your root and your birth are from the land of Canaan; your father was an Amorite, and your mother a Hittite.
verses.16:4: And when you were born, on the day of your birth, your umbilical cord was not cut, and you were not washed with water for health, nor salted with salt, nor wrapped in cloths.
verses.16:5: No eye spared you to do one of these things for you, having compassion on you; rather, you were cast out upon the face of the earth in the rejection of your soul on the day you were born.
verses.16:6: Yet passing by you, I saw you being trampled in your blood; and I said to you while you were in your blood, "Live!" Yes, I said to you, "In your blood, live!"
verses.16:7: I made you multiply like a sprout of the field; and you multiplied and grew tall, and you entered in and reached womanly adornment: your breasts grew full, and your hair grew, yet you were unclothed and full of shame.
verses.16:8: And I passed by you and saw you, and look, your time was the time of lovers; and I spread My cloak over you and covered your disgrace, and I swore to you and entered into a covenant with you, says the Lord God, and you became Mine.
verses.16:9: And I washed you with water, and I cleansed your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.
verses.16:10: And I clothed you in multicolored garments, and I shod you with violet leather, and I wrapped you in fine linen, and I dressed you in fine fabrics;
verses.16:11: and I adorned you with adornment, and I placed bracelets on your hands and a necklace around your neck;
verses.16:12: and I placed a ring upon your face, and rings for your ears, and a crown of splendor upon your head.
verses.16:13: And you were adorned with gold and silver, and you were clothed in fine linen, brocade, and multicolored fabrics; you ate fine flour, honey, and oil, and you became exceedingly beautiful, and you advanced to royalty.
verses.16:14: And your name went out among the nations because of your loveliness, because you were perfect in My splendor which I had placed upon you, says the Lord God.
verses.16:15: And having confidence in your beauty, you committed fornication on account of your name, and you offered your fornication to every passerby, so that you might become his.
verses.16:16: And taking from your garments, you made for yourself high places stitched together on every side, and you committed fornication upon them such as has not been done, nor will be.
verses.16:17: And you took the vessels of your splendor from My gold and My silver which I gave to you, and you made for yourself male images, and you committed fornication with them.
verses.16:18: And you took your multicolored garments and covered them, and you set My oil and My incense before them.
verses.16:19: And My bread which I gave to you, fine flour and oil and honey with which I nourished you, you placed in their sight as a sweet aroma; and so it was done, says the Lord God.
verses.16:20: And you took your sons and your daughters whom you bore to Me, and you sacrificed them to them to be devoured. Is your fornication a small matter?
verses.16:21: You sacrificed My sons and gave them to them, consecrating them.
verses.16:22: And after all your abominations and fornications, you did not remember the days of your youth, when you were unclothed and full of shame, trampled in your blood.
verses.16:23: And it happened after all your wickedness (woe, woe to you! says the Lord God),
verses.16:24: and you built for yourself a house of harlotry, and you made for yourself a booth of harlotry in all the public squares.
verses.16:25: At the head of every road you built a sign of your harlotry, and you made your splendor abominable, and you parted your feet for every passerby, and you multiplied your fornications;
verses.16:26: and you committed fornication with the sons of Egypt, your neighbors, great in flesh, and you multiplied your fornication to provoke Me.
verses.16:27: Look, I will stretch out My hand over you, and I will take away your justification, and I will give you over to the desires of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who blush at your wicked way.
verses.16:28: And you committed fornication with the sons of the Assyrians because you were not yet filled; and after you committed fornication, not even thus were you satisfied;
verses.16:29: and you multiplied your fornication in the land of Canaan with the Chaldeans, and not even thus were you satisfied.
verses.16:30: With what shall I cleanse your heart, says the Lord God, when you do all these works of a woman who is a harlot and brazen?
verses.16:31: Because you constructed your house of harlotry at the head of every road, and you made your high place in every public square; yet you did not become like a harlot increasing the price through disdain,
verses.16:32: but like an adulterous woman, who brings in strangers over her husband.
verses.16:33: To all harlots wages are given, yet you gave wages to all your lovers, and you kept giving gifts to them so that they would come in to you from every side to commit fornication with you.
verses.16:34: And it happened in you contrary to the custom of women in your fornications, and after you there will be no fornication; for in that you gave wages and did not receive wages, the opposite happened in you.
verses.16:35: Therefore, harlot, hear the word of the Lord.
verses.16:36: This is what the Lord God says: Because your bronze has been poured out and your disgrace has been uncovered in your fornications upon your lovers and upon the idols of your abominations, in the blood of your sons whom you gave to them,
verses.16:37: look, I will gather all your lovers with whom you mingled, and all whom you loved, together with all whom you hated; and I will gather them against you from every side, and I will uncover your disgrace before them, and they will see all your shamefulness.
verses.16:38: And I will judge you by the judgments of adulteresses and of those who shed blood, and I will give you over to the blood of fury and jealousy.
verses.16:39: And I will give you into their hands, and they will destroy your house of harlotry and tear down your booth of harlotry; and they will strip you of your garments and take away the vessels of your splendor, and leave you unclothed and full of disgrace;
verses.16:40: and they will bring a crowd against you, and they will stone you with stones and cut you down with their swords;
verses.16:41: and they will burn your houses with fire and execute judgments upon you in the sight of very many women. And you will cease committing fornication, and you will no longer give wages;
verses.16:42: and My indignation will rest upon you, and My jealousy will be taken away from you; and I will be calm and will be angry no more.
verses.16:43: Because you did not remember the days of your youth, and you provoked Me in all these things, therefore I also have brought your ways upon your head, says the Lord God, and I have not acted according to your wicked deeds in all your abominations.
verses.16:44: Look, everyone who speaks a common proverb will take it up against you, saying, "Like mother, so also is her daughter."
verses.16:45: You are the daughter of your mother, who cast away her husband and her sons; and you are the sister of your sisters, who cast away their husbands and their sons: your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
verses.16:46: And your older sister is Samaria, she and her daughters, who dwell to your left; while your sister younger than you, who dwells to your right, is Sodom and her daughters.
verses.16:47: Yet you neither walked in their ways nor acted according to their wicked deeds a very little less; you have done almost more wicked deeds than they in all your ways.
verses.16:48: As I live, says the Lord God, your sister Sodom, she and her daughters, have not done as you and your daughters have done.
verses.16:49: Look, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread and abundance, and the idleness of her and her daughters; and they did not extend a hand to the needy and the poor;
verses.16:50: and they were lifted up and committed abominations before Me; and I took them away, as you have seen.
verses.16:51: And Samaria did not commit half of your sins, but you surpassed them in your wicked deeds, and you justified your sisters by all your abominations which you practiced.
verses.16:52: Therefore you also bear your shame, you who surpassed your sisters by your sins, acting more wickedly than they; for they have been justified by you. Therefore you also be put to shame and bear your disgrace, you who justified your sisters.
verses.16:53: And I will turn, restoring them with the restoration of Sodom with her daughters, and with the restoration of Samaria and her daughters, and I will restore your return in the midst of them,
verses.16:54: so that you may bear your disgrace and be put to shame for all that you have done, comforting them.
verses.16:55: And your sister Sodom and her daughters will return to their former state, and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former state, and you and your daughters will return to your former state.
verses.16:56: Yet your sister Sodom was not heard in your mouth in the day of your pride,
verses.16:57: before your wickedness was uncovered, as at this time, to the reproach of the daughters of Syria and of all the daughters of the Philistines around you, who surround you on every side.
verses.16:58: You yourself have borne your wickedness and your disgrace, says the Lord God.
verses.16:59: For this is what the Lord God says: And I will do to you as you have despised the oath, so as to make the covenant void;
verses.16:60: yet I will remember My covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish for you an everlasting covenant.
verses.16:61: And you will remember your ways and be put to shame when you receive your sisters who are older than you together with your younger ones; and I will give them to you as daughters, but not from your covenant.
verses.16:62: And I Myself will establish My covenant with you, and you will know that I am the Lord;
verses.16:63: so that you may remember and be put to shame, and may no longer open your mouth because of your shame, when I have been appeased toward you for all that you have done, says the Lord God.'"
verses.17:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.17:2: "Son of man, propose a riddle and tell a parable to the house of Israel,
verses.17:3: and you will say, 'This is what the Lord God says: A great eagle of large wings, with a long span of limbs, full of feathers and variegation, came to Lebanon and took the pith of the cedar.
verses.17:4: It tore off the tip of its boughs and carried it across to the land of Canaan; it placed it in a city of merchants.
verses.17:5: And it took from the seed of the land and placed it in soil for seed, so that it might establish a root by many waters; it placed it on the surface.
verses.17:6: And when it had sprouted, it grew into a rather broad vine, of low stature, with its branches looking toward it, and its roots were under it; therefore it became a vine, and bore fruit into shoots, and sent out offshoots.
verses.17:7: And there was another great eagle, with large wings and many feathers; and look, this vine, as if sending its roots toward it, stretched out its shoots toward it, so that it might water it from the small beds of its growth.
verses.17:8: In good soil by many waters it has been planted, so that it may produce boughs and bear fruit, so that it may become a great vine.'
verses.17:9: Say, 'This is what the Lord God says: Will it then prosper? Will he not pull up its roots and pluck off its fruits, and dry up all the shoots of its growth, and it will wither, and not with a great arm nor with many people, so as to pull it up by the roots?
verses.17:10: Look, it is planted: will it then prosper? When the burning wind touches it, will it not dry up, and wither in the beds of its growth?'"
verses.17:11: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.17:12: "Say to the provoking house, 'Do you not know what these things signify?' Say, 'Look, the king of Babylon comes to Jerusalem, and will take the king and its princes, and will bring them to himself in Babylon.
verses.17:13: And he will take from the seed of the kingdom, and will strike a covenant with him, and will receive an oath from him. Moreover, he will also take the mighty ones of the land,
verses.17:14: so that the kingdom may be lowly and not be lifted up, but may keep his pact and observe it.
verses.17:15: Yet he, withdrawing from him, sent messengers to Egypt, so that it might give him horses and many people. Will the one who did these things prosper, or obtain safety? And he who broke the pact, will he escape?
verses.17:16: As I live, says the Lord God, surely in the place of the king who appointed him king, whose oath he made void, and he broke the pact that he had with him, in the midst of Babylon he will die.
verses.17:17: And neither with a great army nor with many people will Pharaoh wage battle against him, at the casting up of a mound and at the building of ramparts, to kill many souls.
verses.17:18: For he had despised the oath so as to break the covenant, and look, he gave his hand; and since he has done all these things, he will not escape.
verses.17:19: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: As I live, surely the oath that he despised, and the covenant that he transgressed, I will place upon his head.
verses.17:20: And I will spread My net over him, and he will be caught in My dragnet; and I will bring him to Babylon, and I will judge him there for the transgression by which he despised Me.
verses.17:21: And all his fugitives, with his entire host, will fall by the sword; and those who remain will be scattered to every wind; and you will know that I, the Lord, have spoken.
verses.17:22: This is what the Lord God says: I Myself will also take from the pith of the lofty cedar and set it; from the top of its branches I will pluck off what is tender, and I will plant it upon a high and towering mountain.
verses.17:23: On the lofty mountain of Israel I will plant it, and it will burst forth into growth, and produce fruit, and become a large cedar; and all birds will dwell under it, and every winged creature will nest under the shade of its boughs;
verses.17:24: and all the trees of the region will know that I, the Lord, have brought low the lofty tree and exalted the lowly tree, and have dried up the green tree and made the dry tree leaf out. I, the Lord, have spoken, and I have done it.'"
verses.18:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.18:2: "What is it that among yourselves you turn a parable into this proverb in the land of Israel, saying, 'The fathers ate a sour grape, and the teeth of the children grow numb'?
verses.18:3: As I live, says the Lord God, this parable will no longer be a proverb for you in Israel.
verses.18:4: Look, all souls are Mine: as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is Mine; the soul that sins, that very one will die.
verses.18:5: And if a man is righteous, and does judgment and righteousness,
verses.18:6: does not eat on the mountains, and does not lift up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, and does not violate his neighbor's wife, and does not approach a menstruating woman,
verses.18:7: and does not distress a person, returns the pledge to the debtor, seizes nothing by violence, gives his bread to the hungry, and covers the naked with a garment,
verses.18:8: does not lend at interest and does not take more, turns his hand away from iniquity, and renders true judgment between man and man,
verses.18:9: walks in My precepts, and keeps My judgments so as to practice truth: this man is righteous; he will certainly live, says the Lord God.
verses.18:10: But if he fathers a son who is a robber, shedding blood, and who does one of these things,
verses.18:11: and indeed not doing all these things, but eating on the mountains, and defiling his neighbor's wife,
verses.18:12: distressing the needy and the poor, seizing plunder, not returning a pledge, and lifting up his eyes to idols, committing abomination,
verses.18:13: giving at interest and taking more: will he live? He will not live. Since he has done all these detestable things, he will certainly die; his blood will be upon himself.
verses.18:14: Now if he fathers a son who, seeing all the sins of his father that he committed, fears and does not do anything like them,
verses.18:15: does not eat upon the mountains, and does not lift up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, and does not violate his neighbor's wife,
verses.18:16: and does not distress a man, does not withhold a pledge, and does not seize plunder, gives his bread to the hungry, and covers the naked with a garment,
verses.18:17: turns his hand away from injury to the poor, does not take interest and excess, executes My judgments, walks in My precepts: this man will not die in the iniquity of his father, but will certainly live.
verses.18:18: As for his father, because he committed extortion, and did violence to his brother, and practiced evil in the midst of his people, look, he has died in his iniquity.
verses.18:19: And you say, 'Why has the son not borne the iniquity of the father?' Clearly because the son has practiced judgment and righteousness, has kept all My precepts, and has done them, he will certainly live.
verses.18:20: The soul that sins, that very one will die: the son will not bear the iniquity of the father, and the father will not bear the iniquity of the son; the righteousness of the righteous man will be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked man will be upon him.
verses.18:21: But if the wicked man repents from all his sins that he has practiced, and keeps all My precepts, and does judgment and righteousness, he will certainly live, and he will not die.
verses.18:22: None of all his iniquities that he has practiced will I remember; in his righteousness that he has practiced, he will live.
verses.18:23: Is the death of the wicked man My will, says the Lord God, and not that he should turn back from his ways and live?
verses.18:24: But if the righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity according to all the abominations that the wicked man is accustomed to practice, will he live? None of all his righteous deeds that he had done will be remembered; in the transgression by which he has transgressed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them he will die.
verses.18:25: And you have said, 'The way of the Lord is not fair!' Hear therefore, house of Israel: is My way not fair, and are your ways not rather crooked?
verses.18:26: For when a righteous man turns away from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will die in them; in the unrighteousness that he has practiced, he will die.
verses.18:27: And when a wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has practiced, and does judgment and righteousness, he himself will keep his soul alive;
verses.18:28: for, considering and turning away from all his iniquities that he has practiced, he will certainly live, and he will not die.
verses.18:29: And the children of Israel say, 'The way of the Lord is not fair!' Are My ways not fair, house of Israel, and are your ways not rather crooked?
verses.18:30: Therefore I will judge each one according to his ways, house of Israel, says the Lord God. Turn back and repent from all your iniquities, and iniquity will not become a ruin for you.
verses.18:31: Cast away from yourselves all your transgressions in which you have transgressed, and make for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit; and why will you die, house of Israel?
verses.18:32: For I do not desire the death of the one who dies, says the Lord God: return and live."
verses.19:1: "And you, take up a lamentation over the princes of Israel,
verses.19:2: and you will say, 'Why did your mother, a lioness, lie down among lions? Did she nourish her cubs in the midst of young lions?
verses.19:3: And she brought up one of her young lions, and he became a lion; and he learned to seize prey and to eat a man.
verses.19:4: And the nations heard about him, and not without their own wounds they captured him, and they brought him in chains to the land of Egypt.
verses.19:5: And when she saw that she had grown weak, and her expectation had perished, she took one of her young lions; she made him a lion.
verses.19:6: And he walked among the lions, and became a lion; and he learned to seize prey and to devour men;
verses.19:7: he learned to make widows and to turn their cities into a desert; and the land and its fullness were made desolate at the sound of his roaring.
verses.19:8: And the nations gathered against him from every side, out of the provinces, and spread their net over him; in their wounds he was captured,
verses.19:9: and they put him in a cage; in chains they brought him to the king of Babylon, and they put him into prison, so that his voice would no longer be heard upon the mountains of Israel.
verses.19:10: Your mother, like a vine in your blood, was planted by the water; her fruit and her boughs grew from many waters.
verses.19:11: And she came to have solid rods for scepters of rulers, and her stature was exalted among the boughs, and she saw her height in the multitude of her shoots.
verses.19:12: And she was pulled up in wrath and cast down to the ground, and the burning wind dried up her fruit; the rods of her strength withered and dried out; fire consumed her.
verses.19:13: And now she is transplanted into the desert, in a pathless and thirsty land.
verses.19:14: And fire went out from a rod of her branches, which consumed her fruit; and there was no strong rod in her, a scepter of rulers.' It is a lamentation, and it will be for a lamentation."
verses.20:1: And it happened in the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth of the month, that men from the elders of Israel came to inquire of the Lord, and they sat before me.
verses.20:2: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.20:3: "Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel, and you will say to them, 'This is what the Lord God says: Have you really come to inquire of Me? As I live, I will not answer you, says the Lord God.'
verses.20:4: If you judge them, if you judge, son of man, show them the abominations of their fathers.
verses.20:5: And you will say to them, 'This is what the Lord God says: On the day when I chose Israel, and lifted up My hand for the offspring of the house of Jacob, and appeared to them in the land of Egypt, and lifted up My hand for them, saying, "I am the Lord your God,"
verses.20:6: on that day I lifted up My hand for them to lead them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had provided for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is outstanding among all lands.
verses.20:7: And I said to them, "Let each one cast away the offenses of his eyes, and do not be defiled with the idols of Egypt; I am the Lord your God."
verses.20:8: And they provoked Me and were unwilling to listen to Me; not one cast aside the abominations of his eyes, nor did they abandon the idols of Egypt. And I said that I would pour out My indignation upon them and fulfill My anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
verses.20:9: And I acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned before the nations in whose midst they were, and among whom I appeared to them to lead them out of the land of Egypt.
verses.20:10: Therefore I brought them out of the land of Egypt, and I led them out into the desert.
verses.20:11: And I gave them My precepts, and I showed them My judgments, by doing which a man will live in them.
verses.20:12: Moreover, I also gave them My Sabbaths, so that they would be a sign between Me and them, and they would know that I am the Lord who sanctifies them.
verses.20:13: And the house of Israel provoked Me in the desert: they did not walk in My precepts, and they cast aside My judgments, by doing which a man will live in them, and they greatly profaned My Sabbaths. Therefore I said that I would pour out My fury upon them in the desert and consume them;
verses.20:14: and I acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned before the nations from which I brought them out in their sight.
verses.20:15: I therefore lifted up My hand over them in the desert, that I would not bring them into the land that I gave them, flowing with milk and honey, the foremost of all lands,
verses.20:16: because they cast aside My judgments, and did not walk in My precepts, and profaned My Sabbaths; for their heart was going after idols.
verses.20:17: And My eye spared them, so that I would not kill them, nor did I consume them in the desert.
verses.20:18: But I said to their sons in the wilderness, "Do not walk in the precepts of your fathers, nor keep their judgments, nor be defiled with their idols.
verses.20:19: I am the Lord your God: walk in My precepts, keep My judgments and do them,
verses.20:20: and sanctify My Sabbaths, so that they may be a sign between Me and you, and you may know that I am the Lord your God."
verses.20:21: And the sons exasperated Me: they did not walk in My precepts, and they did not keep My judgments to do them, which, when a man has done, he will live in them, and they profaned My Sabbaths. And I threatened to pour out My fury upon them and fulfill My anger against them in the desert.
verses.20:22: But I turned away My hand and acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned before the nations from which I brought them out before their eyes.
verses.20:23: Again I lifted up My hand against them in the wilderness, to scatter them among the nations and winnow them into the lands,
verses.20:24: because they had not done My judgments, and had rejected My precepts, and had profaned My Sabbaths, and their eyes had been after the idols of their fathers.
verses.20:25: Therefore I also gave them precepts that were not good, and judgments in which they will not live.
verses.20:26: And I defiled them in their gifts, when they offered everything that opens the womb, on account of their sins; and they will know that I am the Lord.'
verses.20:27: For this reason, speak to the house of Israel, son of man, and you will say to them, 'This is what the Lord God says: Yet in this also your fathers blasphemed Me, when they had spurned Me with contempt;
verses.20:28: and when I had brought them into the land over which I lifted up My hand to give it to them, they saw every high hill and every leafy tree, and they sacrificed their victims there, and they gave there the provocation of their offering, and they placed there the aroma of their sweetness, and they poured out their libations.
verses.20:29: And I said to them, "What is the high place to which you go in?" And its name has been called High Place to this day.'
verses.20:30: Therefore say to the house of Israel, 'This is what the Lord God says: Surely in the way of your fathers you defile yourselves, and you commit fornication after their stumbling blocks,
verses.20:31: and in the offering of your gifts, when you pass your sons through the fire, you defile yourselves with all your idols until today; and will I answer you, house of Israel? As I live, says the Lord God, I will not answer you.
verses.20:32: Nor will the thought of your mind come about, you who say, "We will be like the nations and like the clans of the earth, to worship wood and stones."
verses.20:33: As I live, says the Lord God, with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with fury poured out, I will reign over you.
verses.20:34: And I will lead you out from the peoples, and I will gather you from the lands in which you have been scattered; with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with fury poured out, I will reign over you.
verses.20:35: And I will bring you into the desert of the peoples, and I will enter into judgment with you there face to face.
verses.20:36: Just as I contended in judgment against your fathers in the desert of the land of Egypt, so I will judge you, says the Lord God.
