verses.20:37: And I will subject you to My scepter, and I will bring you into the bonds of the covenant.
verses.20:38: And I will pick out from among you the transgressors and the ungodly, and I will lead them out of the land of their sojourning, and they will not enter the land of Israel; and you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.20:39: And as for you, house of Israel, this is what the Lord God says: Each of you, walk after your idols and serve them. But if even in this you do not listen to Me, and you defile My holy name any longer with your gifts and with your idols,
verses.20:40: on My holy mountain, on the high mountain of Israel, says the Lord God, there all the house of Israel will serve Me, all of them, I say, in the land in which they will be pleasing to Me; and there I will require your firstfruits and the beginning of your tithes, in all your consecrated things.
verses.20:41: As an aroma of sweetness I will accept you, when I have led you out from the peoples and have gathered you from the lands into which you have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the eyes of the nations.
verses.20:42: And you will know that I am the Lord, when I have brought you to the land of Israel, into the land for which I lifted up My hand to give it to your fathers.
verses.20:43: And there you will remember your ways and all your wicked deeds, by which you have been defiled in them; and you will be displeasing to yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that you have done.
verses.20:44: And you will know that I am the Lord, when I have done good to you for the sake of My name, and not according to your evil ways, nor according to your most wicked deeds, house of Israel, says the Lord God.'"
verses.21:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.21:2: "Son of man, set your face toward the way of the south, and let words drop toward the southwest, and prophesy to the forest of the southern field.
verses.21:3: And you will say to the southern forest, 'Hear the word of the Lord. This is what the Lord God says: "Look, I will kindle a fire in you, and I will burn up in you every green tree and every dry tree. The flame of the burning will not be extinguished, and every face from the south to the north will be burned up in it,
verses.21:4: and all flesh will see that I, the Lord, have kindled it, and it will not be extinguished."'"
verses.21:5: And I said, "Ah, ah, ah, Lord God! They themselves say of me, 'Does this man not speak in parables?'"
verses.21:6: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.21:7: "Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, and let words drop toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the ground of Israel.
verses.21:8: And you will say to the land of Israel, 'This is what the Lord God says: "Look, I am against you, and I will draw My sword out of its sheath, and I will kill in you the righteous and the wicked.
verses.21:9: Now because I have killed in you the righteous and the wicked, therefore My sword will go out from its sheath against all flesh, from the south to the north,
verses.21:10: so that all flesh may know that I, the Lord, have drawn My sword out of its sheath beyond recall."'
verses.21:11: And you, son of man, groan with a breaking of the loins, and groan in bitterness before them.
verses.21:12: And when they say to you, 'Why are you groaning?' you will say, 'Because of the report, for it is coming, and every heart will melt, and all hands will go limp, and every spirit will grow faint, and waters will flow down all knees. Look, it is coming, and it will happen, says the Lord God.'"
verses.21:13: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.21:14: "Son of man, prophesy, and you will say, 'This is what the Lord God says: Speak, "A sword, a sword is sharpened and polished.
verses.21:15: It is sharpened to slaughter victims; it is polished to shine. You who move the scepter of My son, you have cut down every tree.
verses.21:16: And I have given it to be burnished, so that it may be held by the hand; this sword is sharpened, and this one is polished, so that it may be in the hand of the killer."'
verses.21:17: Cry out and wail, son of man, for it has come upon My people, it is upon all the leaders of Israel who had fled; they have been handed over to the sword with My people. Therefore strike your thigh,
verses.21:18: for it has been tested; and this too, when it overthrows the scepter, and it will be no more, says the Lord God.
verses.21:19: You therefore, son of man, prophesy, and strike hand against hand; and let the sword be doubled, and let the sword of those killed be tripled. This is the sword of great slaughter, which causes them to be stunned
verses.21:20: and to melt in heart, and multiplies ruins. At all their gates I have placed the turmoil of the sword that is sharp, and polished to flash, wrapped for slaughter.
verses.21:21: Sharpen yourself, go to the right or to the left, wherever the desire of your face is.
verses.21:22: Indeed, I also will clap hand to hand, and I will fulfill My indignation; I, the Lord, have spoken."
verses.21:23: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.21:24: "And you, son of man, lay out for yourself two roads, so that the sword of the king of Babylon may come. Both of them will go out from one land; and with his hand he will take a conjecture; at the head of the road to the city he will conjecture.
verses.21:25: You will lay out a road so that the sword may come to Rabbah of the sons of Ammon, and to Judah, into strongly fortified Jerusalem.
verses.21:26: For the king of Babylon stood at the fork in the road, at the head of the two roads, seeking divination, mixing arrows; he questioned the idols, he consulted the entrails.
verses.21:27: At his right hand came the divination against Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open his mouth in slaughter, to lift up his voice in howling, to set battering rams against the gates, to heap up a mound, to build fortifications.
verses.21:28: And he will be like one consulting an oracle in vain in their eyes, and imitating the rest of the Sabbaths; yet he himself will remember iniquity in order to capture them.
verses.21:29: Therefore, this is what the Lord God says: 'Because you have remembered your iniquity, and have uncovered your transgressions, and your sins have appeared in all your thoughts, because, I say, you have remembered, you will be captured by hand.'
verses.21:30: And you, profane, wicked leader of Israel, whose day has come, appointed in the time of iniquity,
verses.21:31: this is what the Lord God says: 'Remove the turban, take off the crown. Is this not the one that raised up the humble and humbled the lofty?
verses.21:32: Iniquity, iniquity, iniquity I will make it; and this has not happened until he should come to whom judgment belongs, and I will hand it over to him.'
verses.21:33: And you, son of man, prophesy and say, 'This is what the Lord God says to the sons of Ammon and concerning their reproach,' and you will say, 'Blade, blade, unsheathed for killing, polished so that you may put to death and flash,
verses.21:34: while vain things were seen for you, and lies were divined, so that you might be placed upon the necks of the wounded wicked, whose day has come, appointed in the time of iniquity.
verses.21:35: Return to your sheath. In the place in which you were created, in the land of your birth, I will judge you.
verses.21:36: And I will pour out My indignation upon you; in the fire of My fury I will blow upon you, and I will give you into the hands of men who are foolish and who fashion destruction.
verses.21:37: You will be food for the fire; your blood will be in the midst of the land; you will be handed over to oblivion, for I, the Lord, have spoken.'"
verses.22:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.22:2: "And you, son of man, do you not judge, do you not judge the city of bloodshed?
verses.22:3: And you will show her all her abominations, and you will say, 'This is what the Lord God says: "A city shedding blood in her midst, so that her time may come, and that has made idols against herself, so that she might be defiled.
verses.22:4: By your blood, which was shed by you, you have become guilty, and by your idols, which you have made, you have been defiled. And you have made your days draw near, and you have brought on the time of your years; therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations, and a mockery to all lands.
verses.22:5: Those that are near and those that are far from you will triumph over you, you filthy, renowned one, great in destruction.
verses.22:6: Look, the princes of Israel, each with his own arm, have been in you to shed blood.
verses.22:7: They have treated father and mother with insults; in you they have extorted from the foreigner in your midst; they have grieved the orphan and the widow within you.
verses.22:8: You have spurned My sanctuaries, and you have defiled My Sabbaths.
verses.22:9: Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood, and upon the mountains they have eaten in you; they have committed wickedness in your midst.
verses.22:10: They have uncovered the nakedness of a father in you; they have humbled the uncleanness of a menstruating woman in you.
verses.22:11: And each man has committed an abomination with his neighbor's wife, and a father-in-law has wickedly defiled his daughter-in-law; a brother has violated his sister, the daughter of his father, in you.
verses.22:12: They have taken bribes within you to shed blood; you have taken interest and excess gain, and you greedily extorted from your neighbors, and you have forgotten Me, says the Lord God.
verses.22:13: Look, I have struck My hands together over your greed that you have practiced, and over the blood that has been shed in your midst.
verses.22:14: Will your heart endure, or will your hands prevail, in the days that I will make for you? I, the Lord, have spoken, and I will do it.
verses.22:15: And I will scatter you among the nations, and I will winnow you into the lands, and I will make your uncleanness cease from you.
verses.22:16: And I will possess you in the sight of the nations, and you will know that I am the Lord."'"
verses.22:17: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.22:18: "Son of man, the house of Israel has been turned into dross for Me; all of these are bronze, and tin, and iron, and lead in the midst of the furnace; they have become the dross of silver.
verses.22:19: Therefore, this is what the Lord God says: 'Because all of you have been turned into dross, therefore, look, I will gather you in the midst of Jerusalem,
verses.22:20: with a gathering of silver, and bronze, and tin, and iron, and lead in the midst of a furnace, to kindle a fire in it for melting. So I will gather you in My fury and in My wrath, and I will rest, and I will melt you.
verses.22:21: And I will gather you, and I will kindle you in the fire of My fury, and you will be melted in the midst of it.
verses.22:22: As silver is melted in the midst of a furnace, so you will be in the midst of it; and you will know that I am the Lord, when I have poured out My indignation upon you.'"
verses.22:23: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.22:24: "Son of man, say to her, 'You are an unclean land, and not rained upon in the day of fury.'
verses.22:25: There is a conspiracy of prophets in her midst; like a roaring lion seizing prey, they have devoured lives; they have taken wealth and valuables; they have multiplied her widows in the midst of her.
verses.22:26: Her priests have despised My law, and they have defiled My sanctuaries; they have kept no distinction between the holy and the profane, and they have not discerned between the defiled and the clean; and they have turned their eyes away from My Sabbaths, and I was profaned in their midst.
verses.22:27: Her princes in the midst of her are like wolves seizing prey, to shed blood, and to destroy lives, and to pursue gain greedily.
verses.22:28: And her prophets were plastering them without tempering, seeing vain things, and divining falsehood for them, saying, 'This is what the Lord God says,' when the Lord has not spoken.
verses.22:29: The peoples of the land practiced extortion and robbed violently; they afflicted the needy and the poor, and they oppressed the foreigner with extortion without justice.
verses.22:30: And I sought from among them a man who would put up a hedge and stand in opposition against Me for the land, so that I would not destroy it; and I found no one.
verses.22:31: And I have poured out My indignation upon them; in the fire of My wrath I have consumed them. I have returned their way upon their head, says the Lord God."
verses.23:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.23:2: "Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother;
verses.23:3: and they committed fornication in Egypt; in their youth they committed fornication. There their breasts were pressed, and the breasts of their puberty were crushed.
verses.23:4: Now their names were Oholah the older, and Oholibah her younger sister; and I possessed them, and they bore sons and daughters. Furthermore, as for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem is Oholibah.
verses.23:5: Therefore Oholah committed fornication against Me, and went mad over her lovers, over the Assyrians drawing near,
verses.23:6: clothed in violet, princes and magistrates, young men of desire, all of them horsemen, riders of horses.
verses.23:7: And she bestowed her fornications upon those chosen ones, all the sons of the Assyrians; and with all those over whom she went mad, she was defiled in their impurities.
verses.23:8: Moreover, she did not abandon her fornications that she had had in Egypt; for they also slept with her in her youth, and they crushed the breasts of her puberty, and poured out their fornication upon her.
verses.23:9: Therefore I delivered her into the hands of her lovers, into the hands of the sons of Assyria, over whose lust she went mad.
verses.23:10: They themselves uncovered her disgrace; they took away her sons and daughters, and her they killed with the sword. And the women became notorious, and they executed judgments upon her.
verses.23:11: When her sister Oholibah saw this, she went mad with lust more than she did, and her fornication, beyond the fornication of her sister,
verses.23:12: she shamelessly offered to the sons of the Assyrians, to commanders and magistrates coming to her, clothed in multicolored attire, to horsemen who rode on horses, and to young men, all of them outstanding in appearance.
verses.23:13: And I saw that the single way of both of them was defiled.
verses.23:14: And she increased her fornications; and when she saw men depicted on the wall, images of the Chaldeans portrayed in colors,
verses.23:15: and girded with belts around their waists, and with dyed turbans on their heads, the appearance of commanders, all of them, the likeness of the sons of Babylon and of the land of the Chaldeans in which they were born,
verses.23:16: she went mad over them with the craving of her eyes, and she sent messengers to them in Chaldea.
verses.23:17: And when the sons of Babylon came to her, to the bed of breasts, they defiled her with their debaucheries; and she was defiled by them, and her soul was satiated by them.
verses.23:18: She also laid bare her fornications, and uncovered her disgrace; and My soul withdrew from her, just as My soul had withdrawn from her sister.
verses.23:19: For she multiplied her fornications, remembering the days of her youth, in which she committed fornication in the land of Egypt.
verses.23:20: And she went mad with lust over intercourse with those whose flesh is like the flesh of donkeys, and like the emission of horses is their emission.
verses.23:21: And you revisited the wickedness of your youth, when your breasts were pressed in Egypt, and the breasts of your puberty were crushed.
verses.23:22: Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Lord God says: 'Look, I will raise up all your lovers against you, with whom your soul has been satiated, and I will gather them against you all around:
verses.23:23: the sons of Babylon and all the Chaldeans, nobles, and tyrants, and princes, all the sons of the Assyrians, young men outstanding in appearance, all the commanders and magistrates, princes of princes, and renowned riders of horses.
verses.23:24: And they will come upon you equipped with chariot and wheel, a multitude of peoples; with breastplate, and shield, and helmet they will be armed against you on every side. And I will set judgment before them, and they will judge you by their judgments.
verses.23:25: And I will set My jealousy against you, which they exercise with you in fury: they will cut off your nose and your ears, and whatever remains will fall by the sword. They themselves will seize your sons and your daughters, and your last remnant will be devoured by fire.
verses.23:26: And they will strip you of your garments, and take away the vessels of your glory.
verses.23:27: And I will make your wickedness cease from you, and your fornication from the land of Egypt; and you will not lift up your eyes to them, and you will remember Egypt no more.'
verses.23:28: For this is what the Lord God says: 'Look, I will deliver you into the hands of those whom you hate, into the hands of those with whom your soul has been satiated.
verses.23:29: And they will deal with you in hatred, and take away all your labors, and leave you naked and full of disgrace; and the disgrace of your fornications will be revealed, your wickedness and your fornications.
verses.23:30: They have done these things to you, because you committed fornication after the nations, among whom you were defiled in their idols.
verses.23:31: You have walked in the way of your sister, and I will put her cup in your hand.'
verses.23:32: This is what the Lord God says: 'You will drink your sister's cup, deep and wide; you will become a mockery and a derision, which is most capacious.
verses.23:33: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of grief and sadness, the cup of your sister Samaria.
verses.23:34: And you will drink it, and drain it down to the dregs; and you will devour its fragments, and you will tear your breasts, for I have spoken,' says the Lord God.
verses.23:35: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: 'Because you have forgotten Me and have cast Me behind your body, you also bear your wickedness and your fornications.'"
verses.23:36: And the Lord said to me, saying: "Son of man, do you judge Oholah and Oholibah, and declare to them their wicked deeds?
verses.23:37: For they have committed adultery, and blood is on their hands, and they have committed fornication with their idols; moreover, even their own sons whom they bore to Me, they offered to them to be devoured.
verses.23:38: And this also they did to Me: they defiled My sanctuary on that day, and profaned My Sabbaths.
verses.23:39: And when they sacrificed their sons to their idols, and entered My sanctuary on that day to defile it, they did even these things in the midst of My house.
verses.23:40: They sent to men coming from far away, to whom they had sent a messenger; and so, look, they came, for whom you washed yourself, and painted around your eyes with antimony, and were adorned with women's finery.
verses.23:41: You sat on a most beautiful couch, and a table was adorned before you; My incense and My ointment you placed upon it.
verses.23:42: And the voice of an exulting multitude was in her; and among the men who were brought from a multitude of people and came from the desert, they put bracelets on their hands and splendid crowns on their heads.
verses.23:43: And I said of her who was worn out in adulteries: 'Now even this one will commit fornication in her fornication.'
verses.23:44: And they went in to her as to a prostitute woman; so they kept going in to Oholah and Oholibah, vile women.
verses.23:45: Therefore they are righteous men; these will judge them by the judgment of adulteresses and by the judgment of those who shed blood, because they are adulteresses, and blood is on their hands.
verses.23:46: For this is what the Lord God says: 'Bring a multitude against them, and deliver them over to tumult and to plunder.
verses.23:47: And let them be stoned with the stones of the peoples, and let them be pierced through with their swords; they will kill their sons and daughters, and burn their houses with fire.
verses.23:48: And I will remove wickedness from the land, and all women will learn not to act according to their wickedness.
verses.23:49: And they will place your wickedness upon you, and you will bear the sins of your idols; and you will know that I am the Lord God.'"
verses.24:1: And the word of the Lord came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, saying,
verses.24:2: "Son of man, write for yourself the name of this day, on which the king of Babylon has firmly established himself against Jerusalem today.
verses.24:3: And you shall speak a parable through a proverb to the provoking house, and you shall say to them, 'This is what the Lord God says: Set on the pot; set it on, I say, and pour water into it.
verses.24:4: Gather its pieces into it, every good part, the thigh and the shoulder, choice and full of bones.
verses.24:5: Take the fattest of the flock, and also stack piles of bones beneath it: its boiling has boiled up, and its bones have been boiled thoroughly in its midst.
verses.24:6: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: Woe to the city of blood, to the pot whose rust is in it, and its rust has not gone out of it! By parts and by its own parts, cast it out; no lot has fallen upon it.
verses.24:7: For her blood is in her midst; she poured it out upon the most gleaming rock; she did not pour it out upon the ground, so that it could be covered with dust.
verses.24:8: So that I might bring up My indignation and exact retribution with vengeance, I set her blood upon the most gleaming rock, so that it would not be covered.
verses.24:9: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: Woe to the city of blood, whose pyre I will make great!
verses.24:10: Heap up the bones, which I will kindle with fire; the flesh will be consumed, and the entire mixture will be cooked, and the bones will waste away.
verses.24:11: Also set it empty upon the burning coals, so that it may grow hot and its bronze may melt, and its defilement may be melted down in its midst, and its rust may be consumed.
verses.24:12: With much labor there has been sweating, and its excessive rust has not gone out of it, not even by fire.
verses.24:13: Your uncleanness is detestable, because I wanted to cleanse you, and you were not cleansed from your filth; nor will you be cleansed beforehand, until I make My indignation rest upon you.
verses.24:14: I, the Lord, have spoken: it will come, and I will act; I will not pass by, nor will I spare, nor will I be appeased; according to your ways and according to your devices I will judge you, says the Lord.'"
verses.24:15: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.24:16: "Son of man, look, I am taking from you the delight of your eyes by a stroke; and you shall not mourn, nor shall you weep, nor shall your tears flow.
verses.24:17: Groan in silence; you shall make no mourning for the dead; let your crown be bound around you, and your sandals shall be on your feet; you shall not veil your face with a covering, nor shall you eat the food of mourners."
verses.24:18: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and my wife died in the evening; and in the morning I did just as He had commanded me.
verses.24:19: And the people said to me, "Why do you not tell us what these things mean that you are doing?"
verses.24:20: And I said to them, "The word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.24:21: 'Speak to the house of Israel, "This is what the Lord God says: Look, I will profane My sanctuary, the pride of your dominion, and the delight of your eyes, and that over which your soul is in dread; your sons and your daughters whom you left behind will fall by the sword.
verses.24:22: And you will do just as I have done: you will not veil your faces with a covering, and you will not eat the food of mourners;
verses.24:23: you will have crowns on your heads and sandals on your feet; you will not mourn nor weep, but you will waste away in your iniquities, and each one will groan to his brother.
verses.24:24: And Ezekiel will be a portent to you; according to all that he has done, you will do when this comes; and you will know that I am the Lord God."
verses.24:25: And you, son of man, look, on the day when I take from them their strength, and the joy of dignity, and the desire of their eyes, upon which their souls rest, their sons and their daughters,
verses.24:26: on that day, when one who flees comes to you to report to you,
verses.24:27: on that day, I say, your mouth will be opened with the one who has fled, and you will speak, and you will be silent no longer; and you will be a portent to them, and you will know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.25:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.25:2: "Son of man, set your face against the sons of Ammon, and you shall prophesy concerning them.
verses.25:3: And you shall say to the sons of Ammon, 'Hear the word of the Lord God. This is what the Lord God says: Because you said, "Aha, aha!" over My sanctuary, because it was profaned, and over the land of Israel, because it was made desolate, and over the house of Judah, because they were led into captivity,
verses.25:4: therefore I will hand you over to the sons of the east as an inheritance; and they will set up their sheepfolds in you, and they will place their tents in you; they themselves will eat your produce, and they themselves will drink your milk.
verses.25:5: And I will make Rabbah a dwelling place for camels, and the sons of Ammon a resting place for flocks; and you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.25:6: For this is what the Lord God says: Because you clapped with your hand and stamped with your foot, and rejoiced with all your passion over the land of Israel,
verses.25:7: therefore, look, I will stretch out My hand over you, and I will hand you over as plunder for the nations, and I will kill you off from the peoples, and destroy you from the lands, and crush you; and you will know that I am the Lord.'
verses.25:8: This is what the Lord God says: Because Moab and Seir have said, 'Look, the house of Judah is like all the nations,'
verses.25:9: therefore, look, I will open the shoulder of Moab from the cities, from its cities, I say, and from its borders, the renowned ones of the land, Beth-jeshimoth, and Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim,
verses.25:10: to the sons of the east along with the sons of Ammon, and I will give it as an inheritance, so that there may no longer be any memory of the sons of Ammon among the nations.
verses.25:11: And on Moab I will execute judgments, and they will know that I am the Lord.
verses.25:12: This is what the Lord God says: Because Idumea has carried out retribution so as to avenge itself on the sons of Judah, and has sinned in offending, and has sought vengeance against them,
verses.25:13: therefore this is what the Lord God says: I will stretch out My hand over Idumea, and I will remove from it man and beast, and I will make it deserted from the south; and those who are in Dedan will fall by the sword.
verses.25:14: And I will lay My retribution upon Idumea by the hand of My people Israel; and they will act in Edom according to My anger and My fury, and they will know My vengeance, says the Lord God.
verses.25:15: This is what the Lord God says: Because the Philistines have carried out vengeance, and have exacted retribution with all their spirit, killing and fulfilling ancient enmities,
verses.25:16: therefore this is what the Lord God says: Look, I will stretch out My hand over the Philistines, and I will kill the killers, and I will destroy the remnant of the coastal region,
verses.25:17: and I will execute great acts of retribution upon them, rebuking them in fury; and they will know that I am the Lord, when I lay My vengeance upon them."
verses.26:1: And it happened in the eleventh year, on the first of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.26:2: "Son of man, because Tyre has said concerning Jerusalem, 'Aha! The gates of the peoples are shattered; she has turned to me; I will be filled; she is deserted,'
verses.26:3: therefore this is what the Lord God says: Look, I am against you, Tyre, and I will cause many nations to rise up against you, just as the surging sea rises up.
verses.26:4: And they will demolish the walls of Tyre, and they will destroy her towers; and I will scrape her dust from her, and I will make her a most gleaming rock.
verses.26:5: She will be a drying place for dragnets in the midst of the sea, for I have spoken, says the Lord God; and she will become plunder for the nations.
verses.26:6: Also her daughters who are in the field will be killed by the sword; and they will know that I am the Lord.
verses.26:7: For this is what the Lord God says: Look, I will bring against Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the north, king of kings, with horses, and chariots, and horsemen, and a company, and a great people.
verses.26:8: Your daughters who are in the field he will kill by the sword, and he will surround you with fortifications, and he will heap up a rampart all around, and he will raise a shield against you;
verses.26:9: and he will direct siege sheds and battering rams against your walls, and he will destroy your towers with his weaponry.
verses.26:10: By the flood of his horses, their dust will cover you; at the sound of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, your walls will shake, when he enters your gates as through the entrance of a demolished city.
verses.26:11: With the hooves of his horses he will trample all your streets; he will cut down your people with the sword, and your noble statues will collapse to the ground.
verses.26:12: They will ravage your wealth; they will plunder your merchandise, and they will destroy your walls, and they will overturn your splendid houses; and they will place your stones, and your timbers, and your dust in the midst of the waters.
verses.26:13: And I will make the multitude of your songs cease, and the sound of your lyres will be heard no more.
verses.26:14: And I will make you a most gleaming rock; you will be a drying place for dragnets, nor will you be built again, for I have spoken, says the Lord God.
verses.26:15: This is what the Lord God says to Tyre: Will not the islands be shaken at the sound of your downfall, and at the groaning of those killed among you, when they are put to death in your midst?
verses.26:16: And all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones, and they will take off their robes, and they will cast off their multicolored garments, and they will be clothed with astonishment; they will sit on the ground, and, stunned, they will marvel at your sudden fall;
verses.26:17: and taking up a lament over you, they will say to you, 'How have you perished, you who dwell in the sea, renowned city, who were strong in the sea with your inhabitants, whom all dreaded?
verses.26:18: Now the ships will be astounded on the day of your terror, and the islands in the sea will be troubled, because no one goes out from you.'
verses.26:19: For this is what the Lord God says: When I make you a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited, and bring the abyss over you, and many waters cover you,
verses.26:20: and I drag you down with those who go down into the pit, to the everlasting people, and I place you in the lowest land, like ancient wastelands, with those who are led down into the pit, so that you will not be inhabited; moreover, when I give glory in the land of the living,
verses.26:21: I will reduce you to nothing, and you will not be; and though sought, you will not be found again forever, says the Lord God."
verses.27:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.27:2: "You, therefore, son of man, take up a lament over Tyre,
verses.27:3: and you will say to Tyre, who dwells at the entrance of the sea, the commerce of the peoples to many islands, 'This is what the Lord God says: Tyre, you have said, "I am of perfect splendor,
verses.27:4: and situated in the heart of the sea." Your neighbors who built you have fulfilled your splendor.
verses.27:5: With fir trees from Senir they constructed you, with all the planks of the sea; they took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.
verses.27:6: Oaks from Bashan they hewed into your oars, and they made your rowing benches for you from Indian ivory, and little cabins from the islands of Italy.
verses.27:7: Multicolored fine linen from Egypt was woven for you into a sail, to be set on the mast; blue and purple from the islands of Elishah became your covering.
verses.27:8: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers; your wise men, Tyre, became your pilots.
verses.27:9: The elders of Gebal and its skilled men had sailors for the service of your varied gear; all the ships of the sea and their sailors were among the people of your trade.
verses.27:10: Persians, and Lydians, and Libyans were in your army as your men of war; they hung shield and helmet in you for your adornment.
verses.27:11: The sons of Arvad with your army were upon your walls all around; and the Pygmies also, who were in your towers, hung their quivers on your walls all the way around; they completed your beauty.
verses.27:12: The Carthaginians were your merchants because of the abundance of all riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead they filled your fairs.
verses.27:13: Greece, Tubal, and Meshech, they were your traders; they brought slaves and bronze vessels to your people.
verses.27:14: From the house of Togarmah they brought horses, and horsemen, and mules to your marketplace.
verses.27:15: The sons of Dedan were your merchants; many islands were the trade of your hand; they exchanged tusks of ivory and ebony as your payment.
verses.27:16: Syria was your merchant because of the abundance of your works; they displayed gems, and purple, and checkered cloth, and fine linen, and silk, and chodchod in your market.
verses.27:17: Judah and the land of Israel, they were your traders in the finest wheat; they displayed balsam, and honey, and oil, and resin in your fairs.
verses.27:18: Damascus was your merchant in the abundance of your works, in the abundance of diverse wealth, in rich wine, in wool of the finest color.
verses.27:19: Dan, and Greece, and Mosel displayed wrought iron in your fairs; stacte and calamus were in your trade.
verses.27:20: Dedan were your traders in carpets for sitting.
verses.27:21: Arabia and all the princes of Kedar, they were the merchants of your hand; with lambs, and rams, and young goats, they came to you as your merchants.
verses.27:22: The sellers of Sheba and Raamah, they were your merchants; with all the finest spices, and precious stone, and gold, which they displayed in your market.
verses.27:23: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden were your merchants; Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad were your sellers.
verses.27:24: They were your merchants in many ways, with wrappings of blue, and of multicolored fabrics, and of precious treasures that were wrapped up and bound tight with cords; they also had cedars in your trade dealings.
verses.27:25: The ships of the sea were your princes in your trade; and you were filled, and exceedingly glorified in the heart of the sea.
verses.27:26: Into many waters your rowers have brought you; the south wind has shattered you in the heart of the sea.
verses.27:27: Your riches, and your treasures, and your manifold equipment, your sailors and your pilots, who handled your gear and were in charge of your people, your men of war also, who were in you, with all your multitude that is in your midst, will fall in the heart of the sea on the day of your ruin.
verses.27:28: At the sound of the outcry of your pilots, the fleets will be thrown into turmoil.
verses.27:29: And all who held the oar will come down from their ships; the sailors and all the pilots of the sea will stand on the land.
verses.27:30: And they will wail over you with a loud voice, and cry out bitterly, and cast dust upon their heads, and be sprinkled with ashes.
verses.27:32: And they will take up a mournful song over you, and lament over you: "Who is like Tyre, who has fallen silent in the midst of the sea?
verses.27:33: You who, at the going forth of your wares from the sea, filled many peoples; with the abundance of your riches and of your peoples, you enriched the kings of the earth.
verses.27:34: Now you are shattered by the sea; in the depths of the waters your wealth and all your multitude that was in your midst have fallen.
verses.27:35: All the inhabitants of the islands have been appalled over you, and all their kings, struck by the tempest, have altered their faces.
verses.27:36: The merchants of the peoples have hissed over you; you have been brought to nothing, and you will not be forever."'"
verses.28:1: And the message of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.28:2: "Son of man, say to the prince of Tyre, 'This is what the Lord God says: Because your heart has been lifted up, and you have said, "I am God, and I have sat in the seat of God in the heart of the sea," although you are a man and not God, and you have set your heart like the heart of God;
verses.28:3: look, you are wiser than Daniel; no secret is hidden from you;
verses.28:4: by your wisdom and understanding you have made strength for yourself, and you have acquired gold and silver in your treasuries;
verses.28:5: by the abundance of your wisdom and by your trade you have multiplied strength for yourself, and your heart has been lifted up in your might.
verses.28:6: Therefore, this is what the Lord God says: Because your heart has been lifted up like the heart of God,
verses.28:7: for this reason, look, I will bring foreigners upon you, the mightiest of the nations; and they will bare their swords against the beauty of your wisdom, and they will defile your splendor.
verses.28:8: They will kill and drag you down, and you will die in the death of those struck down in the heart of the sea.
verses.28:9: Will you really speak, saying, "I am God," before those who kill you, although you are a man and not God, in the hand of those who strike you down?
verses.28:10: You will die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of foreigners, for I have spoken, says the Lord God.'"
verses.28:11: And the message of the Lord came to me, saying: "Son of man, raise a lamentation over the king of Tyre,
verses.28:12: and you will say to him, 'This is what the Lord God says: You were the seal of likeness, full of wisdom, and perfect in splendor.
verses.28:13: You were in the delights of the paradise of God; every precious stone was your covering: sardius, topaz, and jasper; chrysolite, and onyx, and beryl; sapphire, and carbuncle, and emerald; gold was the workmanship of your splendor, and your openings were prepared on the day on which you were created.
verses.28:14: You were an outstretched and protecting cherub, and I placed you on the holy mountain of God; you walked in the midst of fiery stones,
verses.28:15: perfect in your ways from the day of your creation, until iniquity was found in you.
verses.28:16: By the abundance of your trade your inner parts were filled with iniquity, and you sinned; and I cast you out from the mountain of God, and I destroyed you, protecting cherub, from the midst of the fiery stones.
verses.28:17: And your heart was lifted up in your splendor; you destroyed your wisdom in your splendor; I cast you down to the earth; I set you before the face of kings so that they might gaze upon you.
verses.28:18: By the abundance of your iniquities and by the iniquity of your trade, you defiled your sanctification; therefore, I will bring forth fire from your midst to consume you, and I will make you into ashes upon the earth in the sight of all who see you.
verses.28:19: All who see you among the nations will be appalled over you; you have become nothing, and you will not be forever.'"
verses.28:20: And the message of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.28:21: "Son of man, set your face against Sidon, and you will prophesy concerning her,
verses.28:22: and you will say, 'This is what the Lord God says: Look, I am against you, Sidon, and I will be glorified in your midst; and they will know that I am the Lord when I have executed judgments in her and have been sanctified in her.
verses.28:23: And I will send pestilence upon her, and blood in her streets; and those who are killed will fall in her midst by the sword all around, and they will know that I am the Lord.
verses.28:24: And there will no longer be for the house of Israel a stumbling block of bitterness and a thorn bringing pain on every side all around, from those who oppose them; and they will know that I am the Lord God.
verses.28:25: This is what the Lord God says: When I have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they have been scattered, I will be sanctified in them before the nations; and they will dwell in their own land, which I gave to My servant Jacob;
verses.28:26: and they will dwell in it securely, and they will build houses and plant vineyards, and they will dwell confidently, when I have executed judgments upon all who oppose them all around; and they will know that I am the Lord their God.'"
verses.29:1: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the eleventh day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.29:2: "Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and you will prophesy concerning him and concerning all Egypt.
verses.29:3: Speak, and you will say, 'This is what the Lord God says: Look, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, great dragon, who lie in the midst of your rivers and say, "The river is mine, and I made myself."
verses.29:4: And I will put a bridle in your jaws, and I will fasten the fish of your rivers to your scales, and I will draw you out from the midst of your rivers, and all your fish will cling to your scales.
verses.29:5: And I will cast you out into the desert, and all the fish of your river; you will fall upon the face of the earth; you will not be collected, nor will you be gathered; I have given you to the beasts of the earth and to the birds of the sky to be devoured.
verses.29:6: And all the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am the Lord, because you have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel:
verses.29:7: when they grasped you with the hand, you were broken, and you tore their whole shoulder; and when they leaned upon you, you were crushed, and you weakened all their loins.
verses.29:8: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: Look, I will bring a sword upon you, and I will kill from you man and beast.
verses.29:9: And the land of Egypt will become a desert and a desolation; and they will know that I am the Lord, because you have said, "The river is mine, and I made it."
verses.29:10: For this reason, look, I am against you and against your rivers; and I will make the land of Egypt into desolations, devastated by the sword, from the tower of Syene as far as the borders of Ethiopia.
verses.29:11: The foot of man will not pass through it, nor will the foot of beast walk in it, and it will not be inhabited for forty years.
verses.29:12: And I will make the land of Egypt deserted in the midst of deserted lands, and its cities in the midst of overthrown cities, and they will be desolate for forty years; and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and I will winnow them into the lands.
verses.29:13: For this is what the Lord God says: After the end of forty years I will gather Egypt from the peoples among whom they had been scattered.
verses.29:14: And I will lead back the captivity of Egypt, and I will settle them in the land of Pathros, in the land of their birth, and there they will become a lowly kingdom.
verses.29:15: Among the other kingdoms it will be the lowliest, and it will no longer be lifted up above the nations; and I will diminish them so that they will not rule over the peoples.
verses.29:16: Nor will they any longer be a confidence to the house of Israel, teaching iniquity so that they flee and follow them; and they will know that I am the Lord God.'"
verses.29:17: And it happened in the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, on the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.29:18: "Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made his army serve with a great service against Tyre; every head was made bald, and every shoulder was rubbed bare; and no payment was rendered to him, nor to his army, from Tyre, for the service with which he served Me against it.
verses.29:19: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: Look, I will place Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon in the land of Egypt; and he will take its multitude, and he will plunder its booty, and he will seize its spoils; and it will be payment for his army,
verses.29:20: and for the work with which he served against it: I have given him the land of Egypt because he labored for Me, says the Lord God.
verses.29:21: In that day a horn will sprout for the house of Israel, and to you I will give an open mouth in their midst, and they will know that I am the Lord."
verses.30:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.30:2: "Son of man, prophesy, and say, 'This is what the Lord God says: Wail, "Woe, woe for the day!"
verses.30:3: For the day is near, and the day of the Lord is approaching, a day of cloud; it will be the time of the nations.
verses.30:4: And a sword will come into Egypt, and dread will be in Ethiopia, when the wounded fall in Egypt, and its multitude is carried away, and its foundations are destroyed.
verses.30:5: Ethiopia, and Libya, and the Lydians, and all the rest of the common people, and Chub, and the sons of the land of the covenant, will fall with them by the sword.
verses.30:6: This is what the Lord God says: And those who uphold Egypt will collapse, and the pride of its dominion will be destroyed; from the tower of Syene they will fall by the sword in it, says the Lord God of hosts.
verses.30:7: And they will be devastated in the midst of desolate lands, and its cities will be in the midst of deserted cities;
verses.30:8: and they will know that I am the Lord, when I put fire in Egypt, and all its helpers are crushed.
verses.30:9: In that day messengers will go out from My presence in triremes to crush the confidence of Ethiopia; and dread will be in them in the day of Egypt, for without a doubt it will come.
verses.30:10: This is what the Lord God says: I will cause the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
verses.30:11: He and his people with him, the mightiest of the nations, will be brought to destroy the land; and they will unsheathe their swords against Egypt, and they will fill the land with those killed.
verses.30:12: And I will make the channels of the rivers dry, and I will hand over the land into the hands of the most wicked; and I will devastate the land and its fullness by the hand of foreigners: I, the Lord, have spoken.
verses.30:13: This is what the Lord God says: And I will destroy the images, and I will cause the idols to cease from Memphis; and there will no longer be a leader from the land of Egypt, and I will put terror in the land of Egypt.
verses.30:14: And I will destroy the land of Pathros, and I will put fire in Tahpanhes, and I will execute judgments in Alexandria.
verses.30:15: And I will pour out My indignation upon Pelusium, the strength of Egypt, and I will kill the multitude of Alexandria.
verses.30:16: And I will put fire in Egypt; Pelusium will suffer pain like a woman in labor, and Alexandria will be devastated, and in Memphis there will be daily distresses.
verses.30:17: The young men of Heliopolis and Bubastis will fall by the sword, and they themselves will be led away captive.
verses.30:18: And in Tahpanhes the day will grow dark, when I crush the scepters of Egypt there, and the pride of its power comes to an end in it; a cloud will cover it, and its daughters will be led into captivity.
verses.30:19: And I will execute judgments in Egypt, and they will know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.30:20: And it happened in the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh day of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.30:21: "Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and look, it has not been wrapped up so that health might be restored to it, to be bound with cloths and bandaged with linen strips, so that, having regained strength, it might be able to hold the sword.
verses.30:22: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: Look, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and I will crush his arm, strong yet broken, and I will cast the sword down from his hand,
verses.30:23: and I will scatter Egypt among the nations, and I will winnow them in the lands.
verses.30:24: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and I will put My sword in his hand, and I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and they will groan with the groans of one killed before his face.
verses.30:25: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh will fall down; and they will know that I am the Lord, when I put My sword in the hand of the king of Babylon, and he stretches it out over the land of Egypt.
verses.30:26: And I will scatter Egypt among the nations, and I will winnow them into the lands; and they will know that I am the Lord."
verses.31:1: And it happened in the eleventh year, in the third month, on the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.31:2: "Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his people, 'To whom have you become like in your greatness?
verses.31:3: Look, Assyria was like a cedar in Lebanon, beautiful in branches, and leafy with boughs, and lofty in height, and its top was lifted up among the dense boughs.
verses.31:4: Waters nourished it; the deep exalted it; its rivers flowed around its roots, and it sent out its streams to all the trees of the region.
verses.31:5: Therefore its height was lifted up above all the trees of the region, and its limbs were multiplied, and its branches were lifted up because of many waters.
verses.31:6: And when it had stretched out its shadow, in its branches all the birds of the sky made nests; and under its boughs all the beasts of the woodlands gave birth, and under its shade lived the assembly of very many nations.
verses.31:7: And it was most beautiful in its greatness, and in the spreading of its limbs; for its root was beside many waters.
verses.31:8: The cedars were not taller than it in the paradise of God; the fir trees did not equal its top, and the plane trees were not equal to its boughs; no tree of the paradise of God was likened to it and to its beauty.
verses.31:9: For I made it splendid, and with many dense boughs, and all the trees of delight that were in the paradise of God envied it.
verses.31:10: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: Because it was exalted in height, and set its top green and dense, and its heart was lifted up in its height,
verses.31:11: I have handed it over into the hand of the mightiest of the nations; he will surely deal with it; according to its wickedness I have cast it out.
verses.31:12: And foreigners, and the most cruel of the nations, will cut it down and cast it upon the mountains; and in all the valleys its branches will collapse, and its limbs will be broken on all the cliffs of the earth; and all the peoples of the earth will depart from its shade and abandon it.
verses.31:13: Upon its ruin all the birds of the sky lived, and on its branches were all the beasts of the region.
verses.31:14: For this reason none of the trees of the waters will be lifted up in their height, nor will they set their loftiness among the wooded and leafy ones, nor will any that are watered with waters stand in their loftiness; for all of them have been handed over to death, to the farthest earth, in the midst of the sons of men, to those who go down into the pit.
verses.31:15: This is what the Lord God says: On the day when it went down to the underworld, I brought on mourning; I covered it with the deep, and I held back its rivers, and I restrained the many waters; Lebanon was grieved over it, and all the trees of the field were shaken.
verses.31:16: At the sound of its ruin I shook the nations when I led it down to the underworld with those who were going down into the pit; and in the lowest earth all the trees of delight were comforted, the choice and illustrious ones in Lebanon, all that were watered with waters.
verses.31:17: For they also will go down with it into the underworld, to those killed by the sword; and the arm of each one will sit under its shade in the midst of the nations.
verses.31:18: To whom have you been likened, renowned and lofty one among the trees of delight? Look, you have been led down with the trees of delight to the farthest earth; in the midst of the uncircumcised you will sleep, with those who were killed by the sword: this is Pharaoh and all his multitude, says the Lord God.'"
verses.32:1: And it happened, in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the first of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.32:2: "Son of man, take up a lament over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and you will say to him, 'You have been likened to a lion of the nations and to a dragon that is in the sea; and you thrust with a horn in your rivers, and stirred up the waters with your feet, and trampled their rivers.
verses.32:3: Therefore the Lord God says this: "I will spread My net over you in a multitude of many peoples, and I will draw you out in My dragnet.
verses.32:4: And I will cast you onto the earth; upon the face of the field I will fling you, and I will cause all the birds of the sky to dwell upon you, and I will satisfy the beasts of the whole earth from you.
verses.32:5: And I will put your flesh upon the mountains, and I will fill your hills with your gore.
verses.32:6: And I will water the land with the stench of your blood upon the mountains, and the valleys will be filled from you.
verses.32:7: And when you have been extinguished, I will cover the sky and make its stars grow dark; I will veil the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not give its light.
verses.32:8: All the lights of the sky I will make mourn over you, and I will set darkness over your land, says the Lord God, when your wounded have fallen in the midst of the land, declares the Lord God.
verses.32:9: And I will provoke the heart of many peoples when I bring your destruction among the nations, over lands that you do not know.
verses.32:10: And I will make many peoples astounded over you, and their kings will be in dread over you with extreme horror when My sword begins to fly over their faces; and each one will suddenly be stunned for his own life on the day of your ruin."
verses.32:11: For the Lord God says this: "The sword of the king of Babylon will come to you.
verses.32:12: By the swords of the mighty I will cast down your multitude; unconquerable are all these nations, and they will lay waste the pride of Egypt, and its multitude will be dispersed.
verses.32:13: And I will destroy all its livestock that were beside abundant waters; and the foot of man will no longer stir them up, nor will the hoof of livestock disturb them.
verses.32:14: Then I will make their waters most pure, and I will lead their rivers like oil, declares the Lord God,
verses.32:15: when I make the land of Egypt desolate; moreover, the land will be left destitute of its fullness when I strike all its inhabitants, and they will know that I am the Lord."'
verses.32:16: It is a lamentation, and they will lament it; the daughters of the nations will lament it; over Egypt and over its multitude they will lament it, declares the Lord God."
verses.32:17: And it happened in the twelfth year, on the fifteenth of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.32:18: "Son of man, sing a mournful song over the multitude of Egypt, and drag her down, her very self and the daughters of strong nations, to the lowest earth, with those who go down into the pit.
verses.32:20: In the midst of those killed by the sword they will fall; the sword has been given; they have dragged her and all her peoples.
verses.32:21: The most powerful of the strong will speak to him from the midst of the underworld, who went down with his helpers and slept uncircumcised, killed by the sword.
verses.32:22: Assyria is there, and all its multitude; around it are its graves, all of them killed, and those who fell by the sword.
verses.32:23: Their graves have been set in the farthest depths of the pit, and its multitude is placed in a circle around its grave: all of them killed and falling by the sword, who had once caused dread in the land of the living.
verses.32:24: Elam is there, and all its multitude in a circle around its grave: all these killed and collapsing by the sword, who went down uncircumcised to the lowest earth, who set their terror in the land of the living, and bore their disgrace with those who go down into the pit.
verses.32:25: In the midst of those killed they have placed its bed among all its peoples; around it is its grave: all these are uncircumcised and killed by the sword. For they caused their terror in the land of the living, and bore their disgrace with those who go down into the pit; in the midst of those killed they have been placed.
verses.32:26: Meshech and Tubal are there, and all their multitude; around them are their graves: all these are uncircumcised, killed and falling by the sword, because they caused their dread in the land of the living.
verses.32:27: And they will not sleep with the mighty, and those falling, and the uncircumcised, who went down to the underworld with their weapons and laid their swords under their heads, and their iniquities were in their bones, because they became the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.
verses.32:28: And you therefore will be crushed in the midst of the uncircumcised, and you will sleep with those killed by the sword.
verses.32:29: Edom is there, and its kings, and all its leaders, who were placed with their army, with those killed by the sword, and who slept with the uncircumcised and with those who go down into the pit.
verses.32:30: All the princes of the north are there, and all the hunters, who were led down with those killed, terrified and put to shame in their strength, who slept uncircumcised with those killed by the sword, and bore their shame with those who go down into the pit.
verses.32:31: Pharaoh saw them and was comforted over all his multitude that was killed by the sword: Pharaoh and all his army, declares the Lord God.
verses.32:32: For I have put My terror in the land of the living, and he has slept in the midst of the uncircumcised with those killed by the sword: Pharaoh and all his multitude, declares the Lord God."
verses.33:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.33:2: "Son of man, speak to the children of your people, and you will say to them: 'A land, when I bring a sword upon it, and the people of the land take one man from the outermost among them and appoint him over themselves as a watchman,
verses.33:3: and he sees the sword coming upon the land, and blows the trumpet, and announces it to the people:
verses.33:4: then whoever he may be who hears the sound of the trumpet and does not take heed for himself, and the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be upon his own head.
verses.33:5: He heard the sound of the trumpet and did not take heed for himself; his blood will be upon himself. But if he guards himself, he will save his life.
verses.33:6: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not sound the trumpet, and the people do not guard themselves, and the sword comes and takes a life from among them, that one indeed has been seized in his iniquity, but I will require his blood from the hand of the watchman.'
verses.33:7: And you, son of man, I have appointed you as a watchman for the house of Israel; therefore, hearing a word from My mouth, you will announce it to them from Me.
verses.33:8: If, when I say to the wicked man, 'Wicked man, you will surely die,' you do not speak so that the wicked man may guard himself from his way, that wicked man himself will die in his iniquity, but I will require his blood from your hand.
verses.33:9: But if, when you announce to the wicked man that he should turn back from his ways, he does not turn back from his way, he himself will die in his iniquity, whereas you have delivered your own life.
verses.33:10: Therefore you, son of man, say to the house of Israel: 'You have spoken thus, saying, "Our iniquities and our sins are upon us, and in them we are wasting away; how then will we be able to live?"'
verses.33:11: Say to them: 'As I live, says the Lord God, I do not desire the death of the wicked man, but that the wicked man turn back from his way and live. Turn back, turn back from your most evil ways; and why will you die, house of Israel?'
verses.33:12: And so, son of man, say to the children of your people: 'The righteousness of the righteous man will not deliver him on whatever day he sins, and the wickedness of the wicked man will not harm him on whatever day he turns back from his wickedness; and the righteous man will not be able to live in his righteousness on whatever day he sins.
verses.33:13: Even if I say to the righteous man that he will surely live, and trusting in his righteousness he commits iniquity, all his righteous deeds will be given over to oblivion, and in his iniquity which he has practiced, in it he will die.
verses.33:14: But if I say to the wicked man, "You will surely die," and he repents from his sin and practices justice and righteousness,
verses.33:15: and that wicked man restores the pledge, and gives back what was taken by robbery, walks in the commandments of life, and does not do anything unjust, he will surely live and will not die.
verses.33:16: None of his sins that he has committed will be imputed to him; he has practiced justice and righteousness; he will surely live.'
verses.33:17: And the children of your people have said, 'The way of the Lord is not of equal weight,' yet their own way is unjust.
verses.33:18: For when the righteous man departs from his righteousness and commits iniquities, he will die in them.
verses.33:19: And when the wicked man departs from his wickedness and practices justice and righteousness, he will live in them.
verses.33:20: Yet you say, 'The way of the Lord is not right.' I will judge each one of you according to his ways, house of Israel."
verses.33:21: And it happened in the twelfth year, in the tenth month, on the fifth of the month of our exile, one who had fled from Jerusalem came to me, saying, "The city has been laid waste."
verses.33:22: Now the hand of the Lord had come upon me in the evening, before the one who had fled arrived, and He opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning; and with my mouth opened, I was silent no longer.
verses.33:23: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.33:24: "Son of man, those who dwell in these ruins upon the soil of Israel speak, saying, 'Abraham was one, and he possessed the land by inheritance; but we are many; the land has been given to us as a possession.'
verses.33:25: Therefore you will say to them: 'The Lord God says this: "You who eat with blood, and lift up your eyes to your uncleannesses, and shed blood, will you indeed possess the land by inheritance?"'
verses.33:27: These things you will say to them: 'This is what the Lord God says: "As I live, surely those who dwell in the ruins will fall by the sword, and the one who is in the field will be handed over to the beasts to be devoured, while those who are in strongholds and caves will die by pestilence.
verses.33:28: And I will make the land a wasteland and a desert, and its proud strength will fail; and the mountains of Israel will be made desolate, because there will be no one who passes through them;
verses.33:29: and they will know that I am the Lord, when I make their land desolate and deserted, because of all their abominations which they have practiced."'
verses.33:30: And you, son of man, the children of your people, who talk about you beside the walls and in the doorways of the houses, also say one to another, each man to his neighbor, speaking, 'Come, and let us hear what word is going forth from the Lord.'
verses.33:31: And they come to you as if a people were entering, and they sit before you, My people; and they hear your words, yet they do not do them, for they turn them into a song of their mouth, and their heart follows their greed.
verses.33:32: And you are to them like a musical song that is sung with a pleasant and sweet sound; and they hear your words, and they do not do them.
verses.33:33: And when what has been foretold comes (for look, it is coming), then they will know that a prophet has been among them."
verses.34:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.34:2: "Son of man, prophesy concerning the shepherds of Israel; prophesy, and you will say to the shepherds, 'This is what the Lord God says: Woe to the shepherds of Israel who were feeding themselves! Are not the flocks fed by the shepherds?
verses.34:3: You were eating the milk, and clothing yourselves with the wool, and killing what was fat, yet you were not feeding My flock.
verses.34:4: What was weak you did not strengthen, and what was sick you did not heal; what was broken you did not bind up, and what was cast away you did not bring back, and what had been lost you did not seek; but with harshness you were ruling over them, and with force.
verses.34:5: And My sheep were scattered because there was no shepherd; and they came to be devoured by all the beasts of the field, and they were scattered.
verses.34:6: My flocks wandered on all the mountains and on every high hill; and My flocks were scattered over the entire face of the earth, and there was no one who searched; there was no one, I say, who searched.
verses.34:7: Therefore, shepherds, hear the word of the Lord.
verses.34:8: As I live, says the Lord God, surely, since My flocks have become prey, and My sheep have come to be devoured by all the beasts of the field because there was no shepherd, nor indeed did My shepherds seek My flock, but the shepherds were feeding themselves and were not feeding My flocks,
verses.34:9: therefore, shepherds, hear the word of the Lord.
verses.34:10: This is what the Lord God says: Look, I Myself am against the shepherds; I will demand My flock from their hand, and I will make them cease so that they no longer feed the flock, nor will the shepherds feed themselves anymore; and I will rescue My flock from their mouth, and it will no longer be food for them.
verses.34:11: For this is what the Lord God says: Look, I Myself will search for My sheep and look after them.
verses.34:12: Just as a shepherd looks after his flock on the day when he is in the midst of his dispersed sheep, so I will look after My sheep, and I will rescue them from all the places in which they had been scattered on the day of cloud and thick darkness.
verses.34:13: And I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the lands, and lead them into their own land; and I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the streams, and in all the dwelling places of the land.
verses.34:14: In the most fertile pastures I will feed them, and their pastures will be on the high mountains of Israel; there they will rest in green grass, and in rich pastures they will graze upon the mountains of Israel.
verses.34:15: I will feed My sheep, and I will make them lie down, says the Lord God.
verses.34:16: What had been lost I will search for, and what was cast away I will bring back, and what had been broken I will bind up, and what had been weak I will strengthen, and what is fat and strong I will guard; and I will feed them in justice.
verses.34:17: As for you, My flocks, this is what the Lord God says: Look, I am judging between animal and animal, of rams and male goats.
verses.34:18: Was it not enough for you to graze on the good pastures? Moreover, you also trampled the rest of your pastures with your feet; and while you were drinking the purest water, you were muddying the rest with your feet;
verses.34:19: and My sheep were feeding on what had been trampled by your feet, and what your feet had muddied, that they were drinking.
verses.34:20: Therefore, this is what the Lord God says to you: Look, I Myself am judging between the fat animal and the lean:
verses.34:21: because you were pushing with flanks and shoulders, and with your horns you were thrusting all the weak animals until they were scattered abroad,
verses.34:22: I will save My flock, and it will no longer be prey, and I will judge between animal and animal.
verses.34:23: And I will raise up over them one shepherd who will feed them, My servant David; he himself will feed them, and he himself will be their shepherd.
verses.34:24: And I, the Lord, will be their God, and My servant David will be prince in their midst; I, the Lord, have spoken.
verses.34:25: And I will make a covenant of peace with them, and I will make the worst beasts cease from the land; and those who dwell in the wilderness will sleep securely in the woodlands.
verses.34:26: And I will set them around My hill as a blessing, and I will bring down the rain in its season; there will be rains of blessing.
verses.34:27: And the tree of the field will yield its fruit, and the land will yield its produce, and they will be in their own land without fear; and they will know that I am the Lord, when I have broken the chains of their yoke and delivered them from the hand of those who rule over them.
verses.34:28: And they will no longer be prey among the nations, nor will the beasts of the earth devour them; instead, they will dwell confidently, without any terror.
verses.34:29: And I will raise up for them a renowned shoot, and they will no longer be diminished by famine in the land, nor will they bear the reproach of the nations any longer.
verses.34:30: And they will know that I, the Lord their God, am with them, and that they themselves are My people, the house of Israel, declares the Lord God.
verses.34:31: As for you, My flocks, the flocks of My pasture, you are human beings, and I am the Lord your God, says the Lord God.'"
verses.35:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.35:2: "Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and you will prophesy concerning it, and you will say to it,
verses.35:3: 'This is what the Lord God says: Look, I am against you, Mount Seir; and I will stretch out My hand over you, and I will make you desolate and deserted.
verses.35:4: I will demolish your cities, and you will be deserted; and you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.35:5: Because you have been a perpetual enemy, and have delivered the sons of Israel into the hands of the sword in the time of their affliction, in the time of final iniquity,
verses.35:6: therefore, as I live, says the Lord God, surely I will hand you over to blood, and blood will pursue you; and since you hate blood, blood will pursue you.
verses.35:7: And I will make Mount Seir desolate and deserted, and I will remove from it the one who goes and the one who returns.
verses.35:8: And I will fill its mountains with its slaughtered; on your hills, and in your valleys and in the streambeds, those killed by the sword will fall.
verses.35:9: I will hand you over to perpetual wastelands, and your cities will not be inhabited; and you will know that I am the Lord God.
verses.35:10: Because you have said, "The two nations and the two lands will be mine, and I will possess them by inheritance," although the Lord was there,
verses.35:11: therefore, as I live, says the Lord God, surely I will act according to your anger and according to your envy, which you carried out while hating them; and I will be made known through them when I have judged you.
verses.35:12: And you will know that I, the Lord, have heard all your reproaches which you spoke concerning the mountains of Israel, saying, "Deserted, they have been given to us to be devoured."
verses.35:13: And you have risen up against Me with your mouth, and you have spoken your disparaging words against Me; I have heard.
verses.35:14: This is what the Lord God says: While the whole earth rejoices, I will reduce you to a wasteland;
verses.35:15: just as you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was laid waste, so I will do to you: you will be laid waste, Mount Seir, and all Idumea; and they will know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.36:1: "Now you, son of man, prophesy over the mountains of Israel, and you will say, 'Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord.
verses.36:2: This is what the Lord God says: Because the enemy has said about you, "Aha! The everlasting heights have been given to us as an inheritance,"'
verses.36:3: therefore prophesy and say, 'This is what the Lord God says: Because you have been made desolate and trampled all around, and have become an inheritance for the remaining nations, and you have risen onto the lip of the tongue and the reproach of the people,
verses.36:4: therefore, mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord God. This is what the Lord God says to the mountains and hills, to the torrents and valleys and desolate places, to the ruined walls and abandoned cities, which have been plundered and mocked by the remaining nations all around.
verses.36:5: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: Since in the fire of My zeal I have spoken concerning the remaining nations and concerning all Idumea, who gave My land to themselves as an inheritance with joy, with a whole heart and from the soul, and cast it out to lay it waste,'
verses.36:6: therefore prophesy over the soil of Israel, and you will say to the mountains and hills, to the ridges and valleys, 'This is what the Lord God says: Look, I have spoken in My zeal and in My fury, because you have endured the shame of the nations.
verses.36:7: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: I have lifted up My hand, that the nations that are around you will themselves bear their own shame.
verses.36:8: But you, mountains of Israel, sprout your branches and yield your fruit for My people Israel, for their coming is near.
verses.36:9: For look, I am for you, and I will turn to you; and you will be plowed, and you will receive seed.
verses.36:10: And I will multiply men upon you, and all the house of Israel; and the cities will be inhabited, and the ruined places will be restored.
verses.36:11: And I will fill you with men and livestock, and they will multiply and increase; and I will cause you to be inhabited as from the beginning, and I will endow you with greater good things than you had from the start; and you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.36:12: And I will bring men upon you, My people Israel, and they will possess you by inheritance; and you will be an inheritance for them, and you will never again be without them.
verses.36:13: This is what the Lord God says: Because they say about you, "You are a devourer of men and one who chokes your nation,"
verses.36:14: therefore you will no longer eat men, and you will no longer kill your nation, says the Lord God.
verses.36:15: Nor will I cause the shame of the nations to be heard in you any longer, and you will by no means bear the reproach of the peoples, and you will no longer lose your nation, says the Lord God.'"
verses.36:16: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.36:17: "Son of man, the house of Israel lived on their own soil, and they defiled it by their ways and by their practices; their way became like the uncleanness of a menstruating woman before Me.
verses.36:18: And I poured out My indignation upon them for the blood that they poured out upon the land, and with their idols they defiled it.
verses.36:19: And I scattered them among the nations, and they were winnowed into the lands; according to their ways and their devices I judged them.
verses.36:20: And they entered among the nations into which they went, and they defiled My holy name, when it was said about them, 'This is the people of the Lord, and from His land they have gone out.'
verses.36:21: And I spared My holy name, which the house of Israel had defiled among the nations into which they entered.
verses.36:22: Therefore you will say to the house of Israel, 'This is what the Lord God says: It is not for your sake that I will act, house of Israel, but for My holy name, which you defiled among the nations into which you entered.
verses.36:23: And I will sanctify My great name, which has been defiled among the nations, which you defiled in their midst, so that the nations may know that I am the Lord, says the Lord of hosts, when I have been sanctified in you before them.
verses.36:24: For indeed I will take you from the nations, and I will gather you from all the lands, and I will bring you into your own land.
verses.36:25: And I will pour out clean water upon you, and you will be cleansed from all your impurities, and from all your idols I will cleanse you.
verses.36:26: And I will give you a new heart, and I will place a new spirit in your midst; and I will take away the stony heart from your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.
verses.36:27: And I will place My Spirit in your midst, and I will cause you to walk in My precepts, and to keep My judgments and perform them.
verses.36:28: And you will live in the land that I gave to your fathers; and you will be a people for Me, and I will be God for you.
verses.36:29: And I will save you from all your impurities; and I will summon the grain and multiply it, and I will not impose famine upon you.
verses.36:30: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the produce of the field, so that you will no longer bear the reproach of famine among the nations.
verses.36:31: And you will remember your most wicked ways and your practices that were not good, and your iniquities and your crimes will displease you.
verses.36:32: It is not for your sake that I will act, says the Lord God; let it be known to you. Be ashamed and blush over your ways, house of Israel.
verses.36:33: This is what the Lord God says: On the day when I cleanse you from all your iniquities, and cause the cities to be inhabited, and restore the ruined places,
verses.36:34: and the deserted land is cultivated, which formerly was desolate in the eyes of every traveler,
verses.36:35: they will say, "That uncultivated land has become like a garden of delight, and the deserted, destitute, and undermined cities sit fortified."
verses.36:36: And whatever nations are left around you will know that I, the Lord, have built up what was demolished and planted what was uncultivated; I, the Lord, have spoken, and I have done it.
verses.36:37: This is what the Lord God says: Yet in this the house of Israel will find Me, so that I may act for them: I will multiply them like a flock of men,
verses.36:38: like a holy flock, like the flock of Jerusalem at her solemn feasts; so the deserted cities will be full of flocks of men, and they will know that I am the Lord.'"
